items.title: 职业与接单
items.summary: 从作品集、showreel、报价、合同到交付和复购，把“会拍”变成可持续接单。

items.title: Career & Clients
items.summary: From portfolio, showreel, quote, contract, and delivery to repeat work: turn craft into a sustainable client practice.

items.title: 发布与运营
items.summary: 发布不是上传完就结束：母版、平台规格、标题封面、字幕、SEO、上线和 48 小时复盘，要当成一条流水线。

items.title: Release & Distribution
items.summary: Release is a pipeline, not an upload: master, platform specs, title and cover, captions, SEO, launch, and a forty-eight-hour review.

items.title: 影像史
items.summary: 用四条时间线看懂影像技术解决了什么旧问题：摄影、电影、声音、电视、数字与生成。

items.title: Image History
items.summary: Use four timelines to see which old problem each image technology solved: photography, cinema, sound, TV, digital, and generation.

items.title: 媒介素养
items.summary: 用一套固定顺序判断一条视频：来源、剪辑、语境、钱、AI 痕迹、图表、权利。先停三秒，再下结论。

items.title: Media Literacy
items.summary: Judge a video in a fixed order: source, edit, context, money, AI traces, charts, rights. Pause before concluding.

items.title: 14 天真人短片
items.summary: 用 2–4 人小组、一台相机和一支麦，在 14 天里走完定范围、分镜、勘景、通告、拍摄、后期和交付。

items.title: 14-Day Live-Action Short
items.summary: Take a 3–8 minute live-action short from scope to delivery in fourteen days with two to four people, one camera, and one mic.

items.title: 剪辑、调色与声音
items.summary: 从素材整理到交付，走一遍可复用的后期流程：先结构，再声音，最后调色，交付前做一次技术检查。

items.title: Edit, Grade & Sound
items.summary: A reusable post pipeline from ingest to delivery: structure first, sound second, grade last, then a technical check.

items.title: 制片与项目管理
items.summary: 制片不是订盒饭，是把范围、钱、人、时间、许可和风险锁在同一张表上，知道哪一项超了会停拍。

items.title: Producing & Management
items.summary: Producing is not ordering lunch; it locks scope, money, people, time, permits, and risk into one table, and knows which overrun stops the shoot.

items.title: 故事、编剧与分镜
items.summary: 把“有个想法”变成一句能复述的话、三场有变化的戏、8–12 个能执行的镜头，再用一次读稿把解释删掉。

items.title: Story, Script & Storyboard
items.summary: Turn an idea into a repeatable line, three scenes that change, eight to twelve executable shots, and one table read that removes explanation.

items.title: 7 天第一条片
items.summary: 用手机或轻便相机，在 7 天里走完定题、分镜、拍摄、粗剪、字幕和复盘，拿到一条能播放的 60–90 秒短片。

items.title: Your First Film in 7 Days
items.summary: Use a phone or small camera to finish a watchable 60–90 second short in seven days: idea, board, shoot, cut, subtitles, review.

items.title: 演员很僵
items.summary: 演员僵先给一个具体任务，再让他走一步；身体动起来，台词才会松。

items.title: The Actor Is Stiff
items.summary: Give a concrete task and make them walk; movement loosens lines.

items.title: AI 角色漂
items.summary: AI 角色漂，先做角色卡和三视图，再把同一张参考图带进每个镜头。

items.title: AI Characters Drift
items.summary: Build a character sheet and carry one reference into every shot.

items.title: AI 版权不清
items.summary: AI 版权不清，先查训练来源、商用条款和人物授权；不清楚就不要交付。

items.title: AI Rights Are Unclear
items.summary: Check training source, commercial terms, and likeness consent; if unclear, do not deliver.

items.title: AI 画面假
items.summary: AI 画面假，先查眼睛、手、口型和运动；这四处一崩，观众立刻出戏。

items.title: AI Looks Uncanny
items.summary: Check eyes, hands, lip sync, and motion; any one breaks the illusion.

items.title: 底噪很大
items.summary: 底噪大先查房间、空调、线和增益；麦克风最后再换。

items.title: The Audio Has Hiss
items.summary: Check room, air conditioning, cables, and gain; replace the mic last.

items.title: 越轴了
items.summary: 越轴先回到全景，或者加一个中性镜头；不要硬切两个反方向的脸。

items.title: You Crossed the Axis
items.summary: Return to a wide or add a neutral shot; do not hard-cut reversed faces.

items.title: 预算超了
items.summary: 预算超了先停非必要设备，再谈人；超支通常不是单价，是范围变了。

items.title: The Budget Is Over
items.summary: Stop nonessential gear first; overruns usually come from scope, not unit price.

items.title: 客户反复改
items.summary: 客户反复改，先把“目标”写成一句话，再让每次修改对着这句话验收。

items.title: The Client Keeps Revising
items.summary: Write the objective in one sentence and test every revision against it.

items.title: 颜色偏了
items.summary: 颜色偏先找白平衡和混合光，不要一上来调色轮；源头不对，越调越脏。

items.title: The Color Is Off
items.summary: Fix white balance and mixed light before color wheels; grading a bad source gets dirtier.

items.title: 穿帮了
items.summary: 穿帮先拍一张现场照，再对道具、衣服、手和桌面；连续性靠记录，不靠记忆。

items.title: Continuity Broke
items.summary: Photograph the set and match props, wardrobe, hands, and table; continuity is records, not memory.

items.title: 现场吵架
items.summary: 现场吵架先停十分钟，把问题写成“谁在等谁”；不要在人前面分对错。

items.title: The Crew Is Fighting
items.summary: Stop for ten minutes and write who is waiting on whom; do not assign blame in public.

items.title: 暗部很脏
items.summary: 暗部脏先降 ISO、补一点环境光、别硬拉暗部；拉回来的黑是噪点。

items.title: The Shadows Are Dirty
items.summary: Lower ISO, add ambient light, and do not lift shadows hard; lifted black is noise.

items.title: 时间不够
items.summary: 时间不够先砍镜头数和场景数，不砍录音和备份；后期可以省，素材不能少。

items.title: There Is No Time
items.summary: Cut shots and locations, not sound or backup; post can be lean, media cannot.

items.title: 结尾没力
items.summary: 结尾没力，常常是因为人物没有付出代价；让他选一次，再停。

items.title: The Ending Has No Force
items.summary: Weak endings usually mean no cost; make the character choose, then stop.

items.title: 第一个客户怎么接
items.summary: 第一个客户从熟人、社区和小商家开始；先给一个具体方案，不要发作品集大海报。

items.title: How to Get the First Client
items.summary: Start with acquaintances, community, and small shops; send a specific proposal, not a portfolio blast.

items.title: 只有一个模糊想法
items.summary: 模糊想法先别写剧本，先写三句“谁想要什么、被什么挡住、输了会怎样”。

items.title: You Only Have a Vague Idea
items.summary: Do not write a script from a vague idea; write three lines: who wants what, what blocks them, what losing costs.

items.title: 画面很平
items.summary: 画面平通常不是机器问题，是光没有方向、前后景没有分开。

items.title: The Image Looks Flat
items.summary: Flat images usually lack directional light and separated layers, not a better camera.

items.title: 台词像念稿
items.summary: 台词像念稿先删解释、加动作、让演员看着一个人说；不要加更多形容词。

items.title: The Lines Sound Read
items.summary: Cut explanation, add action, and give them a listener; more adjectives make it worse.

items.title: 音乐盖对白
items.summary: 音乐盖对白，先把音乐降 6 dB，再检查是不是根本不需要。

items.title: Music Covers the Dialogue
items.summary: Drop music six dB, then ask whether the scene needs it at all.

items.title: 找不到演员
items.summary: 找不到演员就先拍手、背影、物件和声音；不露脸也能讲一个完整的人。

items.title: You Cannot Find Actors
items.summary: No actors? Shoot hands, backs, objects, and sound; a person can be complete without a face.

items.title: 预算为零
items.summary: 零预算先砍场面，不砍结构；一个能拍完的简单故事，比一个拍不起的好故事强。

items.title: Your Budget Is Zero
items.summary: Cut scale, not structure; a simple film you can finish beats a better one you cannot.

items.title: 镜头不够剪
items.summary: 镜头不够剪，是因为每个镜头只拍了一种景别；补全景、近景和插入。

items.title: You Have No Coverage
items.summary: Coverage fails when every shot is one size; add wide, close, and insert.

items.title: 没有灯怎么拍
items.summary: 没有灯先用窗、白墙、反光板和手机手电；先找方向，再谈亮度。

items.title: You Have No Lights
items.summary: Use window, white wall, reflector, and phone light; find direction before intensity.

items.title: 不会写剧本
items.summary: 不会写剧本就先写八格分镜，每格只写一个动作；动作会逼出对白。

items.title: You Cannot Write a Script
items.summary: If you cannot write a script, board eight shots with one action each; action will force the lines.

items.title: 只有一个房间
items.summary: 一个房间也能拍，只要让空间在片子进行中改变一次：变乱、变空、变暗。

items.title: You Only Have One Room
items.summary: One room works if it changes once during the film: messier, emptier, darker.

items.title: 高光爆了
items.summary: 高光爆了先降一档、换 ND、关掉不必要的 practical；爆掉的像素救不回来。

items.title: The Highlights Are Gone
items.summary: Stop down, add ND, kill unnecessary practicals; clipped pixels do not come back.

items.title: 节奏平
items.summary: 节奏平先改变镜头长度：连续三个同长度镜头，观众就会走神。

items.title: The Pacing Is Flat
items.summary: Vary shot length; three same-length shots in a row lose attention.

items.title: 只有手机
items.summary: 手机拍片先锁曝光和白平衡，再配一个能固定的东西；稳定和收音比镜头重要。

items.title: You Only Have a Phone
items.summary: Lock exposure and white balance, then stabilize the phone; steady image and sound beat lenses.

items.title: 平台不过审
items.summary: 平台不过审先查画面、文字、音乐和承诺；改一条，不要整片重做。

items.title: The Platform Rejected It
items.summary: Check images, text, music, and claims; fix one cause, not the whole film.

items.title: 没有作品集
items.summary: 没有作品集，先做三条 30 秒的“能力片”：会拍人、会拍物、会讲一件事。

items.title: You Have No Portfolio
items.summary: Make three 30-second proof films: a person, an object, a story.

items.title: 报价太低
items.summary: 报价太低，先算天数、设备、后期和修改次数；低价接单会赶走好客户。

items.title: Your Quote Is Too Low
items.summary: Price days, gear, post, and revisions; low quotes repel good clients.

items.title: 一场戏没变化
items.summary: 一场戏没变化，就删掉它，或者让一个人得到/失去一样东西。

items.title: A Scene Has No Change
items.summary: If a scene changes nothing, cut it or let someone gain or lose something.

items.title: 一个人怎么拍
items.summary: 一个人拍先用固定机位和连续动作；不要同时演、拍、跟焦。

items.title: You Are Shooting Alone
items.summary: Use a locked camera and continuous action; do not act, operate, and pull focus at once.

items.title: 开头太慢
items.summary: 开头慢先删前三十秒，从人物已经在做事的地方开始；背景可以后补。

items.title: The Opening Is Too Slow
items.summary: Cut the first thirty seconds and start where someone is already acting; context can wait.

items.title: 字幕难读
items.summary: 字幕难读先减字数、提对比、避开嘴和手；不要靠描边加粗解决。

items.title: The Subtitles Are Hard to Read
items.summary: Cut words, raise contrast, avoid mouth and hands; thicker strokes do not fix it.

items.title: 封面没人点
items.summary: 封面没人点，通常不是不好看，是看不出发生了什么；给一张有动作的脸。

items.title: The Thumbnail Gets No Clicks
items.summary: Weak thumbnails usually lack an action; show a face doing something.

items.title: 标题没信息
items.summary: 标题没信息，先写“谁遇到什么结果”；形容词越多，点击越少。

items.title: The Title Says Nothing
items.summary: Write who meets what result; more adjectives, fewer clicks.

items.title: 片子太长
items.summary: 片子太长先找重复：同一个信息出现两次，就删掉较弱的那次。

items.title: The Film Is Too Long
items.summary: Find repetition: if one idea appears twice, cut the weaker instance.

items.title: 转场很硬
items.summary: 转场硬先找动作、声音或形状的接点；白闪和推拉只能救一次。

items.title: The Transition Is Jarring
items.summary: Find an action, sound, or shape match; white flashes and pushes work once.

items.title: 外景风噪
items.summary: 外景风噪先给麦克风套防风罩，再找背风处；后期降噪救不回被风吞掉的字。

items.title: Wind Noise Outside
items.summary: Use a windshield and find shelter; post cannot recover words eaten by wind.

items.title: 无障碍检查
items.summary: 无障碍检查：字幕、对比度、口述影像、音量、闪烁；交付前逐项过。

items.title: Accessibility Check Kit
items.summary: Accessibility check: captions, contrast, audio description, loudness, flicker; one by one before delivery.

items.title: AI 工作流
items.summary: AI 工作流：脚本、参考图、生成工具、放大、合成、标注；每一步都能回退。

items.title: AI Workflow Kit
items.summary: AI workflow: script, reference, generator, upscale, comp, disclosure; every step reversible.

items.title: 录音入门组合
items.summary: 录音入门组合：枪麦、领夹、录音机、监听耳机；先保对白，再谈环境。

items.title: Audio Starter Kit
items.summary: Audio starter: shotgun, lav, recorder, headphones; dialogue first.

items.title: 最低设备组合
items.summary: 最低设备组合：能拍的机身、一支标准变焦、一个能固定的三脚架、一支能收音的麦。

items.title: Minimum Kit
items.summary: Minimum kit: a camera, one standard zoom, a tripod, and a mic that works.

items.title: 采访双机
items.summary: 采访双机：A 机中景、B 机近景，外加枪麦和备用领夹；剪辑才有选择。

items.title: Interview Two-Camera Kit
items.summary: Interview kit: A camera medium, B close, shotgun, backup lav; the edit gets choices.

items.title: 单灯组合
items.summary: 单灯组合：一盏 COB、一个柔光箱、一块反光板、两个沙袋；先有一个方向。

items.title: One-Light Kit
items.summary: One light: COB, soft box, reflector, two sandbags; one direction first.

items.title: 直播推流
items.summary: 直播推流：相机、采集卡、有线网络、备用热点、本地录制；先保不中断。

items.title: Live Streaming Kit
items.summary: Live kit: camera, capture card, wired network, hotspot backup, local recording; uptime first.

items.title: 备份三件套
items.summary: 备份三件套：读卡器、SSD、机械硬盘；当天拷、当天校验、当天异地。

items.title: Backup Three-Piece Kit
items.summary: Backup kit: reader, SSD, hard drive; offload, verify, and move offsite the same day.

items.title: 旅拍轻装
items.summary: 旅拍轻装：一机一镜、小型稳定器、两电池、一块 ND、一个腰包；先能走一天。

items.title: Travel Kit
items.summary: Travel light: one body, one lens, small stabilizer, two batteries, one ND, one pouch.

items.title: 实验影像案例：一条规则，三次重复
items.summary: 一条 4 分钟实验片：固定机位、一个动作、三次重复、一次打破；声音承担结构，不靠旁白解释。

items.title: Experimental Case: One Rule, Three Repetitions
items.summary: A four-minute experimental film: locked frame, one action, three repetitions, one break; sound carries structure, no narration.

items.title: MV 案例：三个母题撑一首歌
items.summary: 一支 3 分半 MV，5 人、1 天、1 个仓库；不拍剧情，用三个视觉母题跟着歌的结构升级。

items.title: Music Video Case: Three Motifs Hold the Song
items.summary: A three-and-a-half-minute music video with five people, one day, one warehouse: no plot, three visual motifs escalating with the song.

items.title: 新闻现场案例：先核实，再开机
items.summary: 一条 90 秒新闻短片，在 6 小时窗口里核对信源、拍证据、标资料画面，最后把未知留在片子里。

items.title: News Case: Verify Before You Roll
items.summary: A ninety-second news feature made in a six-hour window: verify sources, shoot evidence, label archive, and leave the unknown on screen.

items.title: 旅拍 Vlog 案例：只拍一个发现
items.summary: 一条 90 秒旅拍，一个人、两天、一个小镇、一场雨；不拍航拍合集，只拍“去找一件东西”的过程。

items.title: Travel Vlog Case: One Discovery Only
items.summary: A ninety-second travel vlog: one person, two days, one town, one rainstorm; not a drone reel, but “looking for one thing.”

items.title: 婚礼案例：誓言不能补拍
items.summary: 一场 6 分钟婚礼片，两个机位、12 小时、低照度；先保仪式三件事，再谈情绪和慢动作。

items.title: Wedding Case: Vows Cannot Be Reshot
items.summary: A six-minute wedding film with two cameras, twelve hours, and low light: cover three ritual beats before emotion or slow motion.

items.title: 给演员调整：只给动词，不给形容词
items.summary: 给演员调整时给动词：走慢点、压住火、别碰她；别给“再自然一点”。

items.title: Adjusting Actors: Give Verbs, Not Adjectives
items.summary: Give actors verbs: slower, hold the anger, do not touch her. Never 'be more natural.'

items.title: 复试：用同一段动作对比
items.summary: 复试别让演员重新演一段，让两个人做同一个动作，才看得出差别。

items.title: Callback: Compare the Same Action
items.summary: In a callback, do not give a new scene; give the same action and compare.

items.title: 拍孩子：给任务，不给指令
items.summary: 拍孩子给任务不给指令：把桌上的杯子递给我，比“演得难过一点”有用。

items.title: Directing Children: Give a Task, Not a Line Reading
items.summary: With children, give a task, not an instruction: hand me the cup beats 'look sad.'

items.title: 第一次当导演：先保表演，再保机位
items.summary: 第一次当导演，先保住演员和一场戏，再想着多拍几个机位。

items.title: Directing Debut: Protect Performance Before Coverage
items.summary: On a first directing job, protect the performance and the scene before chasing more coverage.

items.title: 拍不演戏的人：别让他演，给他一件事做
items.summary: 采访对象、店主、家人，越说“自然一点”越僵。给他一个具体动作，一句他自己的话，摄影机往后退一点。

items.title: Directing Non-Actors: Give Them a Task, Not a Performance
items.summary: The more you tell a real person to act natural, the stiffer they get. Give them a task, their own words, and a little more distance.

items.title: 群戏：让每个人都有事做
items.summary: 群戏里每个人都有事做，观众才相信这是一个真实的空间，而不是一排等台词的人。

items.title: Ensemble Scene: Give Everyone a Task
items.summary: In an ensemble scene everyone has a task; only then does the space feel real instead of a row of waiting actors.

items.title: 给演员的笔记：一句能执行的话
items.summary: 给演员的笔记一句就够，而且要能执行；三句建议等于没有建议。

items.title: Notes to Actors: One Executable Sentence
items.summary: One executable sentence is enough for an actor; three suggestions add up to none.

items.title: 表演尺度：镜头越近，动作越小
items.summary: 镜头越近，动作越小；远景里刚好的手势，近景里会像演戏。

items.title: Performance Scale: Closer Camera, Smaller Action
items.summary: The closer the camera, the smaller the action; a gesture that works wide looks acted in a close-up.

items.title: 排练：先走位，再给台词
items.summary: 排练先走位，台词可以拿在手上；身体站对了，话才有地方落。

items.title: Rehearsal: Block First, Lines Later
items.summary: Block first, scripts in hand. Once the body is in the right place, the lines have somewhere to land.

items.title: 采访别问“你有什么感受”：把问题换成动作
items.summary: 一个人回忆不起“感受”，但记得那天先迈了哪只脚。问题越具体，回答越像人话。

items.title: Stop Asking “How Did You Feel”: Ask for an Action
items.summary: People rarely remember a feeling. They remember which foot they moved first. Specific questions get human answers.

items.title: 改编：从真实事件到可拍剧本
items.summary: 改编不是复述事件，而是找到一个能在两个小时里被拍出来的冲突。

items.title: Adaptation: From Real Event to Shootable Scene
items.summary: Adaptation is not retelling an event; it is finding a conflict that can be shot within two hours.

items.title: 人物弧光：不是变好，是选择变了
items.summary: 弧光不是人物从坏变好。是同一个压力下，他第一次选了安全，最后一次选了代价。观众看到的是选择变了，不是性格标签换了。

items.title: Character Arc: Not Better, Different Choices
items.summary: An arc is not a character turning good. Under the same pressure, they first choose safety and finally choose the cost. The audience sees the choice change, not a new personality label.

items.title: 喜剧：先搭预期，再拆
items.summary: 喜剧先让观众准确预测下一秒，再只拆掉一个关键条件。

items.title: Comedy: Build the Expectation, Then Break It
items.summary: Comedy lets the audience predict the next beat, then removes one crucial condition.

items.title: 冲突：两个人都得有道理
items.summary: 吵架不等于冲突。真正的冲突，是两个人要的东西都合理，但只能有一个结果。观众得同时看懂两边，才会替他们难受。

items.title: Conflict: Both Sides Need a Point
items.summary: An argument is not conflict. Real conflict is two valid wants that cannot both win. The audience has to understand both sides before it can hurt.

items.title: 对白：让人物用嘴争，不用嘴解释
items.summary: 对白写不动，常常是因为把人物想说的话都写了出来。好对白每句都在争一个东西，听的人有反应，背景交给画面。

items.title: Dialogue: Let Them Fight with Words, Not Explain
items.summary: Dialogue stalls when the writer says everything the character is thinking. Good lines fight for something, the listener reacts, and the backstory stays on screen.

items.title: 一句话故事：谁想要什么，被什么挡住
items.summary: 把模糊的想法压成一句能拍的话：一个具体的人，想要一个具体的东西，被一个具体的障碍挡住。

items.title: The One-Line Story: Who Wants What, and What Stands in the Way
items.summary: Compress a vague idea into a shootable sentence: a specific person, a specific want, and a specific obstacle.

items.title: 独白：别让人物对着空气演讲
items.summary: 独白不是人物对空气演讲，他得有一个不想听、却又走不开的听众。

items.title: Monologue: Give It a Listener and a Block
items.summary: A monologue needs a listener who cannot easily leave and does not quite want to hear it.

items.title: 改稿：先删解释，再补动作
items.summary: 改稿先删解释，再补一个能看见的动作；两件事常常是同一件事。

items.title: Rewrite: Delete the Explanation, Add the Action
items.summary: In a rewrite, delete the explanation and add a visible action; often they are the same fix.

items.title: 场景描述：只写镜头拍得到的
items.summary: 场景描述只写镜头拍得到的东西：光、动作、物件、声音；心理活动留给演员。

items.title: Scene Description: Only What the Camera Can See
items.summary: Describe only what the camera can see: light, action, objects, sound. Leave inner life to the actor.

items.title: 场与场之间：用动作接，不用字幕
items.summary: 场与场之间用动作、声音或物件接，别用字幕卡解释“三天后”。

items.title: Scene Transitions: Carry an Action Across the Cut
items.summary: Carry an action, a sound, or an object across the cut instead of using a title card to explain time.

items.title: 剧本格式：让全组读得懂
items.summary: 剧本格式不是给文学奖看的，它要让摄影、录音和剪辑一眼找到信息。

items.title: Script Format: Make the Whole Crew Read It the Same Way
items.summary: Script format is not for a literary prize; it helps camera, sound, and edit find information at a glance.

items.title: 短剧剧本：30 秒一个钩子
items.summary: 短剧剧本按“钩子—反转—留扣”写，每三十秒必须发生一件改变局面的事。

items.title: Short Drama: A Hook Every Thirty Seconds
items.summary: Short drama runs on hook, turn, cliff: every thirty seconds something must change the board.

items.title: 潜台词：台词下面那件事
items.summary: 潜台词是人物嘴上说 A、心里要 B；导演的工作是让观众看见那个 B。

items.title: Subtext: The Thing Under the Line
items.summary: Subtext is saying A while needing B; the director's job is to let the audience see the B.

items.title: 读稿会：只记三个问题
items.summary: 读稿会只记三类问题：听不懂、不想看、人物不像。别开成剧本研讨会。

items.title: Table Read: Listen for Three Problems Only
items.summary: A table read tracks three problems only: unclear, boring, out of character. Do not turn it into a seminar.

items.title: 三幕片的骨架：把人物往墙上逼
items.summary: 第一幕给目标，第二幕加阻力，第三幕让选择发生。每一幕只做一件事。

items.title: Three Acts: Put the Character Against a Wall
items.summary: Act one gives a goal, act two applies pressure, act three forces a choice. Each act does one job.

items.title: 旁白：别替观众总结
items.summary: 旁白不是把画面再说一遍。它要么给画面没有的信息，要么给一个人的判断。能拍出来就别念；要念，就短、具体、带偏见。

items.title: Voice-Over: Do Not Summarize What the Picture Already Says
items.summary: Voice-over is not the picture read aloud. It either gives information the picture cannot, or gives one person's judgment. If you can shoot it, do not say it. If you must say it, keep it short, concrete, and biased.

items.title: 结尾：停在选择之后
items.summary: 结尾停在选择之后，别再加一段解释；观众自己补上的那句更有力。

items.title: Ending: Stop After the Choice
items.summary: End after the choice. The sentence the audience supplies is stronger than a closing explanation.

items.title: 中点转向：换方法，不换目标
items.summary: 中点不是反转剧情，而是人物换一种办法去要同一个东西。

items.title: Midpoint Turn: Change the Method, Not the Goal
items.summary: The midpoint is not a plot twist; it is the character changing methods to pursue the same want.

items.title: 障碍升级：同一堵墙越收越紧
items.summary: 同一个障碍连撞三次，每次代价更高，观众才会觉得人物真的被逼到墙角。

items.title: Escalation: Same Wall, Higher Cost
items.summary: Hit the same obstacle three times and raise the cost each time; only then does the character look cornered.

items.title: 场景序列：三场戏推一个变化
items.summary: 一场戏只完成一个变化，三场戏连起来才推得动一个段落。

items.title: A Sequence: Three Scenes, One Change
items.summary: One scene delivers one change; three scenes together move a sequence.

items.title: 短片经济：删掉拍不起的东西
items.summary: 短片先删掉拍不起的场面，再把剩下的东西写得更具体。

items.title: Short-Film Economy: Cut What You Cannot Shoot
items.summary: Cut what you cannot shoot, then make what remains more specific.

items.title: 支线：只留能压主线的一条
items.summary: 支线不是增加热闹，它要在某个时刻把主线逼得更紧。

items.title: Subplot: Only the One That Presses the Main Line
items.summary: A subplot is not extra noise; it must squeeze the main line at one specific point.

items.title: 主题：让人物做出来，不让他说出来
items.summary: 主题不要让人物讲出来，让他在压力下做一个能暴露价值观的选择。

items.title: Theme Through Action, Not Speeches
items.summary: Do not let a character speak the theme; make them choose under pressure and reveal it.

items.title: 欲望与赌注：输了会失去什么
items.summary: 人物想要什么不重要，重要的是得不到会失去什么。

items.title: Want and Stakes: What Does Losing Cost?
items.summary: What a character wants matters less than what losing it costs.

items.title: 动态分镜：先定时长，再补画
items.summary: 动态分镜先定镜头时长和剪辑点，画得糙没关系，节奏错了才是大问题。

items.title: Animatic: Time the Scene Before You Draw It
items.summary: An animatic fixes shot length and cut points first; rough drawings are fine, wrong rhythm is not.

items.title: 分镜评审：让摄影和剪辑先挑错
items.summary: 分镜评审让摄影先挑机位、剪辑先挑缺口，导演最后决定改哪三格。

items.title: Board Review: Let Camera and Edit Find the Gaps
items.summary: In a board review, camera finds positions, edit finds gaps, and the director chooses three panels to fix.

items.title: 插入镜头：一个细节顶一句台词
items.summary: 一个插入镜头能顶掉一句台词：手抖、杯沿、没关的门，都比解释有用。

items.title: Insert Shot: One Detail Beats One Line
items.summary: An insert can replace a line: a shaking hand, a cup rim, an open door.

items.title: 段落分镜：一场戏怎么排镜头
items.summary: 段落分镜不是把剧本一句一句画出来，而是决定这场戏先给观众看什么。

items.title: Sequence Board: Shoot the Scene, Not the Script
items.summary: A sequence board does not illustrate every line; it decides what the audience sees first.

items.title: 镜头表：镜号、景别、动作、时长
items.summary: 镜头表四列就够：镜号、景别、动作、时长；写不清这四样，现场一定乱。

items.title: Shot Sheet: Number, Framing, Action, Duration
items.summary: Four columns are enough: number, framing, action, duration. If these are vague, the set will be chaos.

items.title: 分镜表：把一句话拆成 8 个能拍的镜头
items.summary: 画得丑没关系，现场看得懂就行。一张分镜表只回答三件事：谁、在哪、下一个动作是什么。

items.title: The Shot Sheet: Turn One Line into Eight Shootable Shots
items.summary: It can look rough. The crew just needs to read it. One shot sheet answers three things: who, where, and what happens next.

items.title: 道具连贯：杯子放在哪
items.summary: 道具连贯靠照片：开机前拍桌面、拍手、拍衣服，收工前再拍一次。

items.title: Prop Continuity: Photograph the Table
items.summary: Continuity lives in photos: shoot the table, hands, and wardrobe before and after the take.

items.title: 陈设：用道具说人物
items.summary: 陈设不是买一堆好看的东西，而是让每件道具回答“这个人为什么把它留在这里”。

items.title: Set Dressing: Props Tell the Character
items.summary: Set dressing is not shopping for pretty objects; each prop answers why this person kept it.

items.title: 走位：让人用身体说话
items.summary: 走位不是把演员摆好看，而是让身体在空间里做出关系：谁靠近、谁退、谁挡住谁。

items.title: Blocking: Let the Body Tell the Story
items.summary: Blocking is not pretty placement; it makes relationships visible in space: who approaches, who retreats, who blocks whom.

items.title: 越轴之后，观众会突然找不到方向
items.summary: 两个人对话，摄影机跨到桌子另一边，观众会以为他们换了位置。先定一条线，再决定要不要跨。

items.title: Cross the Line and the Room Disappears
items.summary: Move the camera to the other side of a conversation and the audience thinks the people swapped seats. Pick a line before you cross it.

items.title: 运镜：先问为什么动，再问怎么动
items.summary: 镜头动起来不难，难的是让观众不觉得摄影机在炫耀。动之前先写清楚：观众要跟着谁、发现什么、被什么压住。

items.title: Camera Movement: Ask Why Before How
items.summary: Moving the camera is easy. Keeping the audience from noticing the machine is the work. Write down what they should follow, discover, or feel before you move.

items.title: 构图：先让观众知道看哪里
items.summary: 观众第一眼该看谁，第二眼该看哪，构图就是排这个顺序。先定主体，再管前中后景。

items.title: Composition: Tell the Eye Where to Look
items.summary: Who should the eye hit first, and where does it go second? Composition is that order. Set the subject, then the layers.

items.title: 曝光三角：先把高光保住
items.summary: 快门、光圈、ISO 不是三个平等旋钮。先定运动，再定景深，最后才用 ISO 救场。

items.title: The Exposure Triangle: Protect the Highlights First
items.summary: Shutter, aperture, and ISO are not three equal knobs. Set motion first, depth second, and use ISO last.

items.title: 帧率：动作与慢动作
items.summary: 帧率决定动作的时间感；升格不是慢，是让观众看清一个瞬间。

items.title: Frame Rate: Motion and Slow Motion
items.summary: Frame rate sets how motion feels; high speed does not slow time, it lets the eye study a moment.

items.title: 焦距：先决定观众站多远
items.summary: 广角不是装得下，长焦不是拍得远。焦距先决定观众离人物多远，再决定脸和背景怎么挤。先走位，再换镜头。

items.title: Focal Length: Decide How Close the Audience Stands
items.summary: Wide is not “fit everything in,” and long is not “shoot far away.” Focal length decides how close the audience stands before it decides how the face and background stack. Walk the scene first, then change the lens.

items.title: ND 滤镜：白天大光圈怎么拍
items.summary: ND 滤镜不是压暗画面，是让白天也能开大光圈、保住景深。

items.title: ND Filter: Wide Open in Daylight
items.summary: An ND filter does not darken a picture; it lets you stay wide open in daylight and keep your depth.

items.title: 传感器尺寸：画幅决定什么
items.summary: 传感器尺寸改变的是视角、景深和低光，不是“电影感”本身。

items.title: Sensor Size: What the Frame Really Changes
items.summary: Sensor size changes angle, depth, and low light, not 'cinematic feel' by itself.

items.title: 景别：观众该看见多少
items.summary: 景别不是远景、中景、特写的名词表。它决定观众和人物的距离：看见他站在哪，还是只看见一个眼神。先问这一刀要观众看什么，再决定机位退到哪儿。

items.title: Shot Size: Decide How Much the Audience Sees
items.summary: Shot size is not a vocabulary list of wide, medium, and close. It sets the distance between the audience and the person: do they see where he stands, or only an eye? Ask what this cut needs before moving the camera back.

items.title: 快门角度：运动模糊
items.summary: 快门角度控制运动模糊；180 度是常态，不是唯一答案。

items.title: Shutter Angle: The Amount of Blur
items.summary: Shutter angle controls motion blur. 180 degrees is a default, not a rule.

items.title: 覆盖：别只拍一个角度
items.summary: 覆盖不是多拍几条，而是给剪辑留下能救场的不同信息：全景、近景、插入、反打。

items.title: Coverage: Do Not Shoot One Angle
items.summary: Coverage is not more takes; it gives the edit different information: wide, close, insert, reverse.

items.title: 伪色：一眼看高光
items.summary: 伪色把亮度分成色块，一眼就能看到脸是不是过曝、天空是不是死了。

items.title: False Color: Find the Clip at a Glance
items.summary: False color turns brightness into bands, so clipped skin or a dead sky is obvious at a glance.

items.title: Log 素材：拍的时候想后期
items.summary: Log 不是“灰片更好看”，它把高光和暗部留给后期，前提是曝光和色彩管理做对。

items.title: Log Footage: Shoot for the Grade
items.summary: Log is not 'flat looks pro'; it preserves highlights and shadows for post, if exposure and color are handled.

items.title: 波形图：看曝光，不靠感觉
items.summary: 波形图看亮度分布，不看画面好不好看；先保高光，再决定暗部留多少。

items.title: Waveform: Exposure You Can Measure
items.summary: The waveform measures brightness, not beauty. Protect highlights first, then decide how much shadow to keep.

items.title: 硬光：影子也是构图
items.summary: 硬光不是“难看”，它用影子划分空间；问题通常出在影子落错地方。

items.title: Hard Light: The Shadow Is the Shape
items.summary: Hard light is not ugly; shadows shape the space. The problem is usually that the shadow lands in the wrong place.

items.title: 灯光风格：柔、硬、自然
items.summary: 灯光风格先选一个方向：柔、硬、自然；三个都要，画面就会没有态度。

items.title: Lighting Style: Soft, Hard, Natural
items.summary: Pick one direction first: soft, hard, or natural. All three at once means no attitude.

items.title: 混合光：两种色温别打平
items.summary: 混合光不要全部打成白；保留窗光冷、灯泡暖，空间才有层次。

items.title: Mixed Light: Keep the Two Temperatures
items.summary: Do not white-balance mixed light into one color; keep the cool window and warm bulb for depth.

items.title: 夜景内景：一盏 practical 怎么撑
items.summary: 夜景内景先找画面里能信的实用光，再用一盏小灯补人脸，别把整间房打平。

items.title: Night Interior: One Practical Can Carry a Room
items.summary: Find a practical light the room can believe, then add one small face light. Do not flatten the whole room.

items.title: 实用光：画面里的灯怎么用
items.summary: 画面里的灯要真的亮、真的灭、真的闪，但它照不亮整张脸，只能当动机。

items.title: Practical Light: Use the Lamp in the Frame
items.summary: A lamp in frame must actually turn on, off, or flicker, but it motivates light rather than lighting the face.

items.title: 灯比：先学 ratio，再学灯位
items.summary: 一盏主灯加一块反光板，已经能拍出大部分人物场景。先控制亮暗差，再追求灯位花样。

items.title: Lighting Ratio: Learn the Ratio Before the Positions
items.summary: One key and one reflector can shoot most portrait scenes. Control the contrast first, then collect positions.

items.title: 一扇窗怎么当主光
items.summary: 没有灯组也能拍人脸：先定朝向，再用反光板补一点，最后把背景压下去。

items.title: How to Use One Window as Your Key Light
items.summary: You do not need a lighting kit for a face: set the direction, add a little bounce, then bring the background down.

items.title: 直播编码：码率、推流、备份
items.summary: 直播编码先算上行带宽，再定码率；永远留一条本地录制备份。

items.title: Live Encoding: Bitrate, Uplink, Backup
items.summary: Calculate uplink before bitrate, and always keep a local recording as backup.

items.title: 手持：让呼吸进画面
items.summary: 手持不是乱晃，是把摄影师的呼吸变成节奏；先稳住脚步，再谈晃动。

items.title: Handheld: Let Breathing Into the Frame
items.summary: Handheld is not random shake; it turns the operator's breath into rhythm. Steady the feet first.

items.title: 稳定器：走路的节奏
items.summary: 稳定器最怕碎步；膝盖微屈、脚跟着地、速度均匀，画面才会稳。

items.title: Stabilizer: Walk Like You Mean It
items.summary: Gimbals hate tiny steps. Soft knees, heel-first, even speed.

items.title: 多机位与直播：先把时间码、返送和录制锁死
items.summary: 多机位不是多摆两台机器，而是让三台机器进同一条时间线、同一套返送、同一份录音。任何一个环节没有备份，现场就会从“导播”变成“猜”。

items.title: Multicam and Live: Lock Timecode, Return, and Recording First
items.summary: Multicam is not more cameras. It is three cameras on one timeline, one return, and one audio plan. If any link lacks a backup, directing turns into guessing.

items.title: 多机位同步：时间码与机位图
items.summary: 多机位先画机位图，再对时间码；剪辑要知道哪台机器站在哪。

items.title: Multicam Sync: Timecode and a Camera Map
items.summary: Draw the camera map, then sync timecode. The edit must know which camera stood where.

items.title: B-roll：让那句话有画面
items.summary: 受访者说“每天早上五点出摊”，画面还停在脸上，观众就只能听。B-roll 要把这句话变成看得见的东西。

items.title: B-roll: Give the Sentence a Picture
items.summary: When someone says “I set up at five every morning” and the camera stays on their face, the audience can only listen. B-roll turns that line into something visible.

items.title: 机位高度：蹲下比换镜头有用
items.summary: 同一张脸，机位高一寸，观众就读成另一个人。高度先决定权力关系，再决定景别；换镜头解决不了站错位置。

items.title: Camera Height: Lower Before You Change Lenses
items.summary: The same face at one inch lower reads as a different person. Height sets the power relationship before the shot size; a new lens cannot fix standing in the wrong place.

items.title: 房间先开口：用场景交代人物
items.summary: 人物还没说话，观众已经在读房间：门口有没有鞋、桌上几只杯子、哪盏灯还亮着。场景不是背景，是第一句台词。

items.title: Let the Room Speak First
items.summary: Before anyone speaks, the room is already talking: shoes at the door, two cups on the table, one lamp left on. Set dressing is the first line.

items.title: 拍摄清单写到别人能替你执行
items.summary: 清单要写清楚先拍什么、拍多久、拍不到怎么办。想拍的都写上去，现场反而没法执行。

items.title: Write a Shot List Someone Else Can Run
items.summary: A shot list says what comes first, how long it takes, and what happens if it fails. A wish list says everything at once.

items.title: 场记：每条拍完，都得能接上
items.summary: 场记不是记时间码。他记的是观众会不会发现：杯子换了手、外套扣错了、太阳突然从另一边来。现场多写一行，剪的时候少找一天。

items.title: Continuity: Every Take Has to Cut
items.summary: Continuity is not timecode. It is what the audience will notice: a cup switching hands, a button undone, sunlight jumping to the other side. One extra note on set saves a day in the edit.

items.title: 拍摄许可：公园、地铁、商铺
items.summary: 拍摄许可不是一张纸，它决定你能不能架灯、挡路、拍到招牌。

items.title: Permits: Parks, Transit, Shops
items.summary: A permit is not paper; it decides whether you can stand a light, block a walkway, or frame a sign.

items.title: 风险评估：开机前填一张表
items.summary: 风险评估一页纸：谁可能受伤、什么会掉、出了事谁负责、最近的医院在哪。

items.title: Risk Assessment: Fill One Page Before You Roll
items.summary: One page before rolling: who can get hurt, what can fall, who is in charge, and where the nearest hospital is.

items.title: 现场安全：电线、高处、道路
items.summary: 现场安全先看三样：电线会不会绊人、高处有没有固定、道路有没有车。

items.title: Set Safety: Cables, Heights, Roads
items.summary: Cables, heights, traffic: check those three before anything else on set.

items.title: 吊杆操作：跟着动作走
items.summary: 吊杆跟着动作走，不跟着台词走；台词会停，身体不会。

items.title: Boom Operator: Follow the Action, Not the Line
items.summary: The boom follows action, not lines. Lines stop; bodies keep moving.

items.title: 双系统录音：合板不靠猜
items.summary: 双系统录音要么拍手合板，要么时间码同步；两样都没有，后期只能猜。

items.title: Dual-System Sound: Slate and Timecode
items.summary: Sync dual-system sound with a clap or timecode. With neither, post is guessing.

items.title: 无线领夹：藏麦与备份
items.summary: 领夹麦先解决藏和备份：衣领下、头发里、胶带固定，再录一条备用轨。

items.title: Wireless Lav: Hide It, Back It Up
items.summary: Hide the lav, secure it, and record a backup track before worrying about brand.

items.title: LED 虚拟拍摄：墙、跟踪、同步与色温
items.summary: LED 虚拟拍摄不是“背景换成屏幕”。它把真实光影、相机跟踪、屏幕刷新和后期色彩绑成一条链；任何一项没锁，演员脸上的光就会和背景分开。

items.title: LED Virtual Production: Wall, Tracking, Sync, and Color
items.summary: LED virtual production is not swapping a backdrop for a screen. It binds practical light, camera tracking, panel refresh, and color into one chain; if one link is loose, the light on the actor separates from the background.

items.title: LED 虚拟拍摄：先对跟踪，再对光
items.summary: LED 虚拟拍摄先对跟踪，再对光；跟踪漂了，再漂亮的背景也贴不住。

items.title: LED Volume: Track First, Light Second
items.summary: In LED volume work, lock tracking before lighting. If tracking drifts, no background will stick.

items.title: 口述影像：把画面说给人听
items.summary: 口述影像只讲看不见但必须知道的信息：谁在动、往哪走、手里是什么。

items.title: Audio Description: Say What Matters
items.summary: Audio description says what is invisible but necessary: who moves, where, and what they hold.

items.title: 多语言字幕：别一行塞两种语言
items.summary: 多语言字幕别一行塞两种语言；要么切换字幕轨，要么分版交付。

items.title: Multilingual Subtitles: One Language at a Time
items.summary: Do not stack two languages in one line; switch tracks or deliver separate versions.

items.title: 听障字幕：不只写对白
items.summary: 听障字幕要写清说话人、环境声和重要音效，不只抄对白。

items.title: SDH: More Than Dialogue
items.summary: SDH names speakers, ambience, and important effects; it does not just transcribe dialogue.

items.title: 归档与资产复用：让下一条片子更快
items.summary: 归档不是把文件夹拖进硬盘。它要让下一个人能打开工程、找到素材、知道授权、恢复调色和声音；复用不是翻旧片，是有索引地取用。

items.title: Archive and Asset Reuse: Make the Next Film Faster
items.summary: Archiving is not dragging a folder onto a drive. It lets the next person open the project, find media, know the rights, and restore grade and sound. Reuse is indexed retrieval, not digging through old films.

items.title: 备份恢复：演一次恢复
items.summary: 备份不是复制完就算，随机抽一个文件恢复一次，才算验证。

items.title: Backup Recovery: Rehearse One Restore
items.summary: Backup is not finished when the copy ends; restore one random file to prove it.

items.title: DIT 与数据交接：现场到后期的第一次交接
items.summary: DIT 不是拷卡。它要保证每张卡有校验、每份素材有三份、每个文件名能回到场记、每个代理能对应原素材。

items.title: DIT and Data Handoff: The First Handoff from Set to Post
items.summary: DIT is not card copying. It guarantees checksums, three copies, filenames that trace to the log, and proxies that match source.

items.title: 项目结构：文件夹比软件重要
items.summary: 项目结构先定文件夹和命名，软件换了还能找到素材。

items.title: Project Structure: Folders Beat Software
items.summary: Set folders and naming before software; if the app changes, the media still makes sense.

items.title: 代理与缓存：别让硬盘先满
items.summary: 代理和缓存要放在独立盘，别让剪辑盘先满；满了就会掉帧。

items.title: Proxy and Cache: Do Not Fill the Drive First
items.summary: Keep proxies and cache on a separate drive; a full edit drive drops frames.

items.title: 调色：先统一，再风格
items.summary: 调色先解决白平衡、曝光和镜头匹配，再谈 LUT 和风格。镜头之间不连，风格越多越乱。

items.title: Color: Match First, Style Second
items.summary: Fix white balance, exposure, and shot matching before LUTs and looks. If shots do not match, more style only makes it messier.

items.title: 色彩管理：把 LUT 放在正确的位置
items.summary: 色彩管理不是套一个“电影感 LUT”。它先回答：素材是什么色彩空间、监视器是什么、交付是什么；再把转换放在正确的节点上。

items.title: Color Management: Put the LUT in the Right Place
items.summary: Color management is not applying a cinematic LUT. It answers what the source space is, what the monitor is, and what delivery needs, then puts the transform on the right node.

items.title: HDR：先有 HDR 的素材和监看
items.summary: HDR 不是把 SDR 拉亮；拍摄、监看、交付都得真的支持 HDR。

items.title: HDR: You Need HDR on Set and in the Room
items.summary: HDR is not a brighter SDR; capture, monitoring, and delivery must all support it.

items.title: HDR 全流程：从监看到交付，不要只在最后加亮
items.summary: HDR 不是把 SDR 拉亮，而是从拍摄、监看、调色到平台交付都保留同一套亮度关系。任何一个环节按 SDR 猜，最后都会得到“亮但平”的画面。

items.title: HDR End to End: Do Not Just Brighten at the End
items.summary: HDR is not brightening SDR. It preserves one luminance relationship from capture through monitoring, grading, and delivery. Guess in SDR at any stage and the result is bright but flat.

items.title: LUT：起点不是终点
items.summary: LUT 是起点，不是终点；套完之后还要回到一级校正看黑位和高光。

items.title: LUT: A Starting Point, Not a Finish
items.summary: A LUT is a start, not a finish. Return to primary correction and check blacks and highlights.

items.title: 一级校正：曝光与白平衡
items.summary: 一级校正先解决曝光和白平衡，别用风格掩盖技术问题。

items.title: Primary Correction: Exposure and White Balance
items.summary: Primary correction fixes exposure and white balance first. Do not hide technical problems under a look.

items.title: 示波器：黑位、白位、肤色
items.summary: 示波器先看三件事：黑位有没有死、白位有没有爆、肤色线偏没偏。

items.title: Scopes: Black, White, Skin
items.summary: Scopes answer three things: dead blacks, clipped whites, and skin line drift.

items.title: 二级校正：只改一块颜色
items.summary: 二级校正只改一个区域：脸、天空、衣服；改得越多，越容易假。

items.title: Secondary Correction: Change One Area
items.summary: Secondary correction changes one area: skin, sky, wardrobe. More areas, more fake.

items.title: 归档：三年后还能打开
items.summary: 归档不是把文件拖进硬盘，是保证三年后还能找到、还能打开、还能改。

items.title: Archive: Open It in Three Years
items.summary: Archiving is not dragging files to a drive; it means findable, openable, and editable in three years.

items.title: Conform / Online：套底、回批与母版
items.summary: Conform 不是把剪辑时间线换个软件打开。它要确认每一刀都回到原始素材、每一段都有足够 handles、每一个版本都能回到同一条母版。

items.title: Conform and Online: Relink, Round-Trip, and Master
items.summary: Conform is not opening the edit in another app. It verifies every cut returns to the original media, every clip has enough handles, and every version traces to one master.

items.title: 母版：交付前定一个唯一版本
items.summary: 母版是唯一可信的交付源；平台版、竖版、字幕版都从它派生。

items.title: Mastering: One File to Rule the Delivery
items.summary: The master is the single trusted source; platform, vertical, and subtitled versions derive from it.

items.title: 平台多版本交付：一版母版，多版安全区
items.summary: 一版通投是最贵的省事。母版只有一个，平台版按画幅、时长、字幕、响度和封面分别派生；每个版本都能回到母版。

items.title: Platform Deliverables: One Master, Many Safe Areas
items.summary: One master everywhere is the most expensive shortcut. Keep one master, derive platform versions by frame, runtime, captions, loudness, and cover; every version traces back.

items.title: 技术检查：黑帧、静帧、断音
items.summary: 技术检查按清单看：黑帧、静帧、断音、字幕越界、声道错位。

items.title: QC: Black Frames, Frozen Frames, Dead Audio
items.summary: QC follows a list: black frames, freezes, audio drops, subtitle overflow, channel swaps.

items.title: 剪辑点：让注意力过去
items.summary: 剪不动，不一定素材不够，是切点没选对。一个镜头结束，观众的眼睛、耳朵或动作得有一个着落；三样都没有，切口就会跳。

items.title: Cut Points: Action, Eye Line, Sound
items.summary: A scene that will not cut usually has the wrong cut point, not too little footage. At every cut, the eye, the ear, or an action needs somewhere to land.

items.title: 节奏不是快，是观众什么时候想听下一句
items.summary: 剪得快不等于好看。先删解释，再把切点放在动作上，最后决定哪里该留安静。

items.title: Pacing Is Not Speed; It Is When They Want the Next Line
items.summary: Fast cuts do not make a film good. Cut the explanation, land cuts on movement, then decide where silence belongs.

items.title: 细剪：把粗剪的毛边修掉
items.summary: 细剪不是加特效，是把每个切换、每句呼吸、每个多余半秒修顺。

items.title: Fine Cut: Remove the Rough Edges
items.summary: Fine cutting is not adding effects; it smooths every cut, breath, and extra half-second.

items.title: 混音：先让对白站住，再加音乐
items.summary: 观众可以不听音乐，但不能听不清台词。先把对白压到同一水平，再把音乐推下去；音乐是背景，不是遮羞布。

items.title: Mixing: Land the Dialogue Before the Music
items.summary: The audience can ignore the music; they cannot afford to miss the line. Level the dialogue first, then push the music down. Music is background, not a cover-up.

items.title: 平行剪辑：两条线什么时候交叉
items.summary: 平行剪辑不是来回切，它要让两条线在观众心里产生一个问题：什么时候撞上。

items.title: Parallel Editing: When Do Two Lines Meet?
items.summary: Parallel editing is not back-and-forth; it makes the audience ask when the two lines will collide.

items.title: 代理流程：先能剪，再谈画质
items.summary: 代理不是降低成片质量，是让剪辑先跑起来；原始素材永远留在旁边。

items.title: Proxy Workflow: Cut First, Quality Later
items.summary: Proxies do not lower the final quality; they let the edit move. Keep the originals untouched.

items.title: 粗剪：先让片子成立
items.summary: 粗剪只做一件事：让陌生人看懂谁想要什么、被什么挡住。节奏、调色、配乐都往后放。

items.title: The Rough Cut: Make the Film Work First
items.summary: A rough cut does one thing: let a stranger understand who wants what and what blocks them. Rhythm, grade, and score come later.

items.title: 声音先走：J-cut 与 L-cut
items.summary: 画面切了，声音不必同时切。让下一场的声音先进来，或让上一场的声音留一会儿，硬切就不会撞观众一下。

items.title: Let Sound Cross the Cut: J-cuts and L-cuts
items.summary: Picture does not have to cut at the same time as sound. Let the next scene arrive early, or the last one linger, and the cut stops hitting the audience.

items.title: 字幕：让观众读完，不是逐字抄
items.summary: 字幕不是台词的复制件。它要在观众还来不及读的时候，把意思送进去：一行别太长，一句话别断在错的地方，数字和名字要能一眼认出来。

items.title: Subtitles: Help Them Read, Not Just Transcribe
items.summary: Subtitles are not a transcript. They have to land the meaning before the eye gives up: short lines, breaks at the right place, numbers and names that read at a glance.

items.title: 转场：不是遮住时间，是交代时间
items.summary: 叠化、黑场、划像不是装饰。每一次转场都在回答：过了多久、去了哪里、谁还在。答不清，就硬切。

items.title: Transitions: Mark Time, Do Not Hide It
items.summary: A dissolve, a fade, a wipe is not decoration. Every transition answers: how long, where, and who is still here. If it cannot answer, hard cut.

items.title: 版本管理：别用“final 真的 final”
items.summary: 版本管理用日期、平台、时长和改动原因命名，别用“final 真的 final”。

items.title: Versioning: Never Name It Final
items.summary: Name versions by date, platform, duration, and change reason. Never 'final final.'

items.title: Foley：脚步、衣服、门把手
items.summary: Foley 不是配背景音，它把画面里的动作重新做成声音：脚步、衣服、门把手。

items.title: Foley: Steps, Cloth, Doors
items.summary: Foley does not add ambience; it rebuilds the sound of visible action: steps, cloth, handles.

items.title: 响度：平台目标与真峰值
items.summary: 响度按平台目标交付，真峰值留余量；声音大不等于声音好。

items.title: Loudness: Platform Target and True Peak
items.summary: Deliver to the platform's loudness target and leave true-peak headroom. Loud is not good.

items.title: 配乐剪辑：让音乐跟着动作
items.summary: 配乐不是从头铺到尾，它要在动作转折处进入、退出、留白。

items.title: Music Editing: Let the Music Follow the Action
items.summary: Music does not run wall to wall; it enters, exits, and leaves space at the turn.

items.title: 环境音：别让画面住在真空里
items.summary: 房间的声音不是噪声，是空间。每换一个地方，录三十秒空场；没有人声、没有动作，只有房间。对白一断，环境音接上，观众才不会觉得画面被剪断。

items.title: Room Tone: Do Not Let the Picture Live in a Vacuum
items.summary: The room's sound is not noise; it is the space. In every location, record thirty seconds of nothing: no voices, no movement, just the room. When the dialogue stops, room tone takes over, and the cut stops sounding like a cut.

items.title: 声音：先对白，再音乐
items.summary: 观众可以忍受画面粗糙，但很难忍受听不清。先把对白做干净，再谈音乐和氛围。

items.title: Sound: Dialogue First, Music Later
items.summary: An audience can forgive a rough image, but not dialogue they cannot hear. Clean the voice first, then add music and atmosphere.

items.title: 声音后期先修噪声，再谈氛围
items.summary: 一条片子的声音不舒服，观众不会说“声音不好”，只会说“看不下去”。先处理底噪、电平、同步，再考虑音乐。

items.title: Fix the Noise Before You Build a Mood
items.summary: When a film sounds uncomfortable, the audience rarely says “the sound is bad.” They just stop watching. Fix noise, levels, and sync before reaching for music.

items.title: 声音后期：从对白到终混的顺序
items.summary: 声音后期不是先找音乐。顺序是：对白能听清、环境不断、效果不抢、音乐最后进；每一步都有可检查的结果。

items.title: Sound Post: The Order from Dialogue to Final Mix
items.summary: Sound post does not start with music. The order is: dialogue audible, ambience continuous, effects supporting, music last; each step has a checkable result.

items.title: 片头字：先读清，再谈酷
items.summary: 片头字先保证读得清，再谈风格；观众连片名都没看清，设计就白做了。

items.title: Title Design: Readable Before Cool
items.summary: Title design must be readable before it is cool; if the name is missed, the style is wasted.

items.title: CG 合成：光、影、雾一起对
items.summary: CG 合成先对光的方向、影子的软硬、空气的雾，再谈细节。

items.title: CG Integration: Match Light, Shadow, Atmosphere
items.summary: CG integration matches light direction, shadow softness, and atmosphere before detail.

items.title: 清理：去掉穿帮，不擦掉信息
items.summary: 清理穿帮不是把画面擦空，而是去掉错误的东西，保留观众需要的信息。

items.title: Cleanup: Remove the Mistake, Keep the Information
items.summary: Cleanup removes the mistake, not the information the audience needs.

items.title: 抠像：先抠边缘，再调色
items.summary: 抠像先看边缘，再看颜色；边缘糊了，调色救不回来。

items.title: Keying: Edge First, Color Second
items.summary: Keying checks edges before color. If the edge is mush, grading cannot save it.

items.title: 遮罩：一笔一笔跟
items.summary: 遮罩不是一拉就完，边缘穿过头发、手指、透明物时，只能一帧一帧修。

items.title: Rotoscoping: One Frame at a Time
items.summary: Rotoscoping is not one drag. Hair, fingers, and transparency need frame-by-frame work.

items.title: 跟踪：点要贴在实处
items.summary: 跟踪点要贴在真实、有纹理、不被遮挡的位置；贴在纯色墙上一定漂。

items.title: Tracking: Put the Point on Something Real
items.summary: Put tracking points on real, textured, unoccluded surfaces; a flat wall will drift.

items.title: 合成：先让两层信同一种光
items.summary: 抠得像不等于合得成。边缘之前，先对光的方向、软硬、色温和接触阴影。

items.title: Compositing: Make Both Layers Believe the Same Light
items.summary: A clean key is not a composite. Match direction, softness, color temperature, and contact shadow before touching the edge.

items.title: AI 降噪：先保对白
items.summary: AI 降噪先保人声的齿音和尾音，别把句子修成机器人。

items.title: AI Denoise: Protect the Dialogue First
items.summary: AI denoise must protect sibilance and word tails; do not turn lines into a robot.

items.title: AI 音乐：风格、版权、混音
items.summary: AI 音乐先确认商用授权，再谈风格；混音时把它放到对白下面。

items.title: AI Music: Style, Rights, Mix
items.summary: Clear commercial rights before style, and mix it under the dialogue.

items.title: AI 配音：断句与重音
items.summary: AI 配音先把断句、重音、停顿写进文本，再选音色；音色救不了错误断句。

items.title: AI Voice: Punctuation Is Direction
items.summary: Put pauses, stress, and sentence breaks into the script before choosing a voice; timbre cannot fix bad phrasing.

items.title: 声音克隆：授权、范围、标注
items.summary: 声音克隆写清授权、期限、平台和是否允许再训练；片尾要标注。

items.title: Voice Clone: License, Scope, Label
items.summary: State license, term, platforms, and whether retraining is allowed; label it in the credits.

items.title: AI 角色卡：三视图与固定描述
items.summary: AI 角色卡固定脸型、年龄、发型、服装、气质五个字段，每次生成都带着走。

items.title: AI Character Sheet: Lock the Description
items.summary: Lock five fields: face, age, hair, wardrobe, temperament. Carry them into every generation.

items.title: 服装一致性：同一件衣服怎么锁
items.summary: 服装一致性靠固定描述和参考图，不靠“同一个人”这四个字。

items.title: Wardrobe Consistency: One Outfit, One Description
items.summary: Wardrobe consistency needs a fixed description and reference, not the words 'same person.'

items.title: 数字人手势：别重复
items.summary: 数字人手势最怕循环；每十五秒换一次重心，或者让手离开画面。

items.title: Digital Human Gesture: Break the Loop
items.summary: Break the gesture loop every fifteen seconds: shift weight or take the hands out of frame.

items.title: 数字人口型：辅音先对齐
items.summary: 数字人口型先对辅音，尤其是 p、b、m；元音差一点，观众还能忍。

items.title: Digital Human Lip Sync: Consonants First
items.summary: Align consonants first, especially p, b, m. Small vowel drift is tolerable.

items.title: 数字人声音：授权与克隆
items.summary: 数字人声音先拿授权，再定使用范围；能克隆不等于能随便用。

items.title: Digital Human Voice: Consent and Range
items.summary: Get consent and define the range before cloning a voice. Capability is not permission.

items.title: AI 标注：片头、简介、角标
items.summary: AI 标注要可见、具体、说清哪部分生成了；藏在简介末尾等于没标。

items.title: AI Disclosure: Visible, Specific, Honest
items.summary: Disclosure must be visible, specific, and say what was generated; buried at the end is no disclosure.

items.title: AI 失败案例：错在哪
items.summary: AI 失败案例要写清错在提示、模型还是后期；只说“AI 不行”学不到东西。

items.title: AI Failure Cases: Name the Mistake
items.summary: Name whether the failure was prompt, model, or post. 'AI sucks' teaches nothing.

items.title: 模型对比：按镜头类型测
items.summary: 模型对比别只看总排名，按你的镜头类型测：人脸、手、运动、文字、长镜头。

items.title: Model Comparison: Test by Shot Type
items.summary: Do not compare leaderboards; test by shot type: face, hands, motion, text, long take.

items.title: AI 画面为什么像塑料：光、皮肤、镜头
items.summary: 多数“AI 感”不是模型不够强，而是光从四面八方来、皮肤太干净、镜头太完美。先改这三处。

items.title: Why AI Footage Looks Plastic: Light, Skin, Lens
items.summary: Most “AI look” comes from three places: light from everywhere, skin that is too clean, and a lens that is too perfect. Fix those first.

items.title: 同一间屋子：AI 场景一致性怎么锁
items.summary: AI 最会拍“差不多”的同一间屋子：窗在左，下一镜跑到右。先做场景锚点，再按机位顺序生成，最后用剪辑绕开漂移。

items.title: One Room, Every Shot: Locking AI Scene Consistency
items.summary: AI is great at making a room that is almost the same: window left, then right in the next shot. Build a scene anchor, generate in camera order, and cut around the drift.

items.title: AI 镜头表：一条提示只拍一个镜头
items.summary: AI 镜头表一条提示只拍一个镜头；一条提示塞三件事，模型会自己剪成乱片。

items.title: AI Shot List: One Prompt, One Shot
items.summary: One prompt, one shot. Three events in one prompt become a random montage.

items.title: 镜头提示：景别、角度、焦段
items.summary: 镜头提示写三样：景别、角度、焦段；不写这三样，模型只能猜。

items.title: Camera Prompt: Framing, Angle, Lens
items.summary: Camera prompts need framing, angle, and lens. Without them, the model guesses.

items.title: 角色一致性：一张参考图，一段固定描述
items.summary: 生成一百张脸不难，难的是第一百张还像同一个人。把脸、服装、场景写成可复用的锚点，再开始批量生成。

items.title: Character Consistency: One Reference, One Locked Description
items.summary: Generating a hundred faces is easy. Making the hundredth look like the same person is not. Lock the face, wardrobe, and set into reusable anchors before scaling.

items.title: 数字人：先解决授权，再解决像
items.summary: 做一个数字人，要同时解决形象、声音、口型、手势和标注。少一样，观众就会出戏；品牌和新闻尤其要慎用。

items.title: Digital Humans: Rights Before Resemblance
items.summary: A digital human has to solve likeness, voice, lip sync, gesture, and disclosure at once. Miss one and the audience drops out; brands and news should be extra careful.

items.title: 图生视频：首帧、尾帧、运动
items.summary: 先把一张图做对，再让它动。首帧和尾帧定住，中间的运动会自己收敛；提示词写再长也替代不了这两张图。

items.title: Image-to-Video: First Frame, Last Frame, Motion
items.summary: Get one image right, then make it move. Lock the first and last frame; the motion in between settles itself. No prompt length can replace those two frames.

items.title: 运动控制：让镜头按路线走
items.summary: 运动控制先写机位路线：从哪起、经过什么、停在哪；只说“镜头运动”等于没说。

items.title: Motion Control: Give the Camera a Route
items.summary: Give the camera a route: where it starts, what it passes, where it stops. 'Camera moves' says nothing.

items.title: 负面约束：先排除什么
items.summary: 负面约束先排掉最破坏画面的东西：闪烁、多指、文字乱码、脸部变形。

items.title: Negative Prompt: Remove Before You Add
items.summary: Remove what ruins the frame first: flicker, extra fingers, garbled text, face morphing.

items.title: 提示词结构：主体、动作、环境、镜头
items.summary: 提示词按四段写：谁、做什么、在哪、镜头怎么放；顺序稳定，结果才稳定。

items.title: Prompt Structure: Subject, Action, Space, Camera
items.summary: Build prompts in four parts: who, doing what, where, camera. Stable order gives stable output.

items.title: 文生视频：先写镜头，不写形容词
items.summary: 文生视频先写镜头和动作，别写“电影感、史诗感”；模型听不懂形容词。

items.title: Text to Video: Write Shots, Not Adjectives
items.summary: Write shots and actions, not 'cinematic, epic'; the model cannot act on adjectives.

items.title: AI 成片检查：闪烁、手指、文字
items.summary: AI 成片检查先看闪烁、手指、文字和口型；这四样一崩，观众立刻出戏。

items.title: AI Delivery Check: Flicker, Hands, Text
items.summary: Check flicker, hands, text, and lip sync. Any one breaks the illusion.

items.title: AI 补拍：别换掉演员的脸
items.summary: AI 补拍可以换背景、换天气、补人群，别轻易换演员的脸。

items.title: AI Replacement: Do Not Swap the Face
items.summary: AI can replace background, weather, or crowd. Do not casually replace an actor's face.

items.title: 实拍 + AI：先锁实拍，再生成
items.summary: 实拍 + AI 先把实拍锁死，再生成缺的镜头；先生成后补拍，光一定对不上。

items.title: Hybrid Workflow: Lock Live Action First
items.summary: Lock live action before generating missing shots. Generate first and the light will never match.

items.title: AI 剪辑辅助：粗剪不等于成片
items.summary: AI 剪辑辅助可以帮你找素材、切静音，但结构和小动作仍要人来定。

items.title: AI Edit Assist: Rough Cut Is Not a Cut
items.summary: AI can find takes and cut silence, but structure and timing still need a person.

items.title: AI 后期质检：把生成错误挡在交付前
items.summary: AI 片子的质检不是“看起来像不像”。按顺序查：人物、动作、口型、文字、物理、连续性、授权与标注；任何一项不过，不进下一关。

items.title: AI Post QC: Catch Generation Errors Before Delivery
items.summary: AI QC is not “does it look real.” Check in order: identity, motion, lip sync, text, physics, continuity, rights and disclosure. One failure stops the gate.

items.title: AI 抠像：边缘与头发
items.summary: AI 抠像先看头发、手指和透明物；这三处过了，才算能用。

items.title: AI Rotoscope: Hair and Edges
items.summary: Check hair, fingers, and transparency. If those pass, the matte is usable.

items.title: AI 字幕：错字与时间轴
items.summary: AI 字幕先改人名、数字、术语，再调时间轴；自动识别最常错这三类。

items.title: AI Subtitles: Fix Names and Numbers
items.summary: Fix names, numbers, and jargon before timing; automatic transcription fails there most.

items.title: AI 放大：别把噪点放大
items.summary: AI 放大先看噪点和边缘；把噪点放大成细节，是最常见的假清晰。

items.title: AI Upscale: Do Not Sharpen the Noise
items.summary: Check noise and edges before upscaling. Turning noise into detail is the most common fake sharpness.

items.title: 2D 动画：关键帧、Breakdown、循环
items.summary: 2D 不是一张张画得漂亮，而是用关键帧和 breakdown 控制时间。先让一个动作读得懂。

items.title: 2D Animation: Keyframes, Breakdowns, Loops
items.summary: 2D is not about beautiful drawings. It is about controlling time with keys and breakdowns. Make one action read first.

items.title: 二维运镜：pan 与 multiplane
items.summary: 二维运镜不是把整张图平移；用多层不同速度，才有空间。

items.title: 2D Camera: Pan and Multiplane
items.summary: A 2D camera is not one big pan; multiple layers at different speeds create space.

items.title: 二维合成：背景、前景、光
items.summary: 二维合成把背景、人物、光效分层；全压在一张图里，改一个动作就要重画全部。

items.title: 2D Compositing: Separate Background, Character, Light
items.summary: Separate background, character, and light. Flattened layers force a full redraw for one change.

items.title: 口型：先对辅音，再画表情
items.summary: 口型不是把每个字都画出来。先对闭唇的辅音，再给元音开口，表情晚半拍，观众就觉得是他在说。

items.title: Lip Sync: Close on Consonants, Open on Vowels
items.summary: Lip sync is not a drawing for every word. Land the closed consonants, open on the vowels, let the expression arrive late, and the audience believes the voice.

items.title: 走路循环：脚落地那一下
items.summary: 走路看起来难，是因为脚会滑、重心不对、手脚同拍。先把四个姿势站住，再谈风格。

items.title: The Walk Cycle: The Foot Plant
items.summary: Walks look hard because feet slide, weight is wrong, and limbs move together. Lock the four poses first, then talk style.

items.title: 循环动作：首尾怎么接
items.summary: 循环动作首尾帧必须对得上，否则每转一圈就抖一下。

items.title: Loop Cycle: Match the First and Last Frame
items.summary: The first and last frames must match, or the loop twitches every cycle.

items.title: 跑步循环：脚与重心
items.summary: 跑步循环先定重心和脚掌着地顺序，再修手臂；脚不对，全身都飘。

items.title: Run Cycle: Feet and Center of Gravity
items.summary: Set the center of gravity and footfall order before arms; wrong feet make the whole body float.

items.title: 3D 动画管线：从 blockout 到渲染
items.summary: 3D 不是建模完就动画。先 blockout 定时间，再 layout、animation、lighting、render，每一步都能回退。

items.title: The 3D Pipeline: Blockout to Render
items.summary: 3D does not start with animation after modeling. Blockout sets timing, then layout, animation, lighting, and render, each step reversible.

items.title: Blockout：先定比例和机位
items.summary: Blockout 先定比例、机位和时长，不建模细节；这一步错了，后面全返工。

items.title: Blockout: Proportions and Camera First
items.summary: Blockout sets scale, camera, and timing before detail. Get it wrong and everything is redone.

items.title: Layout：镜头与资产交接
items.summary: Layout 把机位、比例、资产版本锁死，再交给动画；交接不清，动画师只能猜。

items.title: Layout: Camera and Asset Handoff
items.summary: Layout locks camera, scale, and asset versions before animation. A vague handoff makes animators guess.

items.title: 三维灯光：三点与 HDRI
items.summary: 三维灯光先用主光、补光、轮廓光定结构，再用 HDRI 补环境；顺序反了，空间会平。

items.title: 3D Lighting: Three Points and HDRI
items.summary: Use key, fill, and rim to build structure, then HDRI for environment. Reverse the order and space flattens.

items.title: 材质：粗糙度与高光
items.summary: 材质先调粗糙度和高光，再贴纹理；这两项决定它是塑料、木头还是金属。

items.title: Materials: Roughness and Specular
items.summary: Roughness and specular decide plastic, wood, or metal before texture maps.

items.title: 建模：面数与轮廓
items.summary: 建模先看轮廓，再看面数；轮廓不对，细分再多也不像。

items.title: Modeling: Silhouette Before Polygons
items.summary: Read the silhouette before polygon count. A wrong outline stays wrong at any density.

items.title: 渲染：采样与噪点
items.summary: 渲染先看采样和噪点，再看分辨率；噪点没压住，4K 也只是更大的脏。

items.title: Render: Samples and Noise
items.summary: Samples and noise come before resolution; unresolved noise at 4K is just bigger dirt.

items.title: 绑定：让关节能转
items.summary: 绑定先让关节转得对，再让皮肤变形好看；转不动，权重再细也没用。

items.title: Rigging: Make the Joints Turn
items.summary: Rigging makes joints turn correctly before skin looks good; if the joint fails, weights cannot save it.

items.title: 短片复盘：从分镜到成片
items.summary: 动画案例复盘按“分镜—animatic—layout—动画—灯光—合成”逐段对照，不只夸成片。

items.title: Animation Case: From Board to Final
items.summary: Review the case through board, animatic, layout, animation, lighting, and comp, not just the final.

items.title: 信息动画：一条线只讲一件事
items.summary: 信息动画一条线只讲一件事；线越多，观众越记不住。

items.title: Infographic Animation: One Line, One Claim
items.summary: One line carries one claim. More lines mean less memory.

items.title: 动效节奏：音乐点与帧
items.summary: 动效节奏先把音乐点对到帧，再决定缓入缓出；点没对上，再顺也乱。

items.title: Motion Rhythm: Music Beats and Frames
items.summary: Land music hits on frames before easing. Miss the hit and smoothness is still chaos.

items.title: 图形转场：形状接形状
items.summary: 图形转场让一个形状变成另一个形状，别用白闪或随便推拉。

items.title: Motion Graphics Transition: Shape to Shape
items.summary: A graphic transition morphs one shape into another, not a white flash or random push.

items.title: 字效：先读清再动
items.summary: 字效先保证静止时读得清，再决定怎么动；边动边读，阅读速度会掉一半。

items.title: Motion Typography: Read, Then Move
items.summary: Type must read at rest before it moves; reading while moving cuts comprehension in half.

items.title: Animatic：配音、定时、改镜头
items.summary: Animatic 先放配音、定每条时长、再改分镜；没有声音，时间感是假的。

items.title: Animatic Pipeline: Voice, Timing, Board
items.summary: Lay temp voice, set duration, then revise the board. Without sound, timing is fiction.

items.title: 资产交接：命名、版本、缓存
items.summary: 资产交接写清命名、版本、缓存和依赖；少一样，下一个人就要重做。

items.title: Asset Handoff: Names, Versions, Cache
items.summary: Handoff states names, versions, cache, and dependencies. Miss one and the next person rebuilds.

items.title: 十二原则：别一次全用
items.summary: 十二原则不是十二个滤镜；一个动作先用一个原则解释，观众才看得懂。

items.title: The Twelve Principles: Use One at a Time
items.summary: The twelve principles are not filters. Use one to explain one action; otherwise the audience sees noise.

items.title: 预备动作：让观众先知道
items.summary: 预备动作让观众提前知道要发生什么；没有预备，动作像突然被剪进来。

items.title: Anticipation: Show the Next Move
items.summary: Anticipation tells the audience what is coming; without it, action feels pasted in.

items.title: 重量：落地的加速度
items.summary: 重量不在姿势，在落地那几帧的加减速；没有加速度，一切像气球。

items.title: Weight: The Acceleration on Landing
items.summary: Weight is not a pose; it is acceleration in the landing frames. Without it, everything floats.

items.title: 人偶骨架：能站住才能演
items.summary: 定格人偶先能站住、能走、能重复，再谈表演；骨架软，拍十帧就塌。

items.title: Armature: It Must Stand Before It Acts
items.summary: A stop-motion puppet must stand, walk, and repeat before acting. A soft armature collapses in ten frames.

items.title: 定格动画：一张一张拍
items.summary: 定格最磨人的地方是稳定：相机别动、光别动、动作每次只改一点。一天拍两秒很正常，别以为自己慢。

items.title: Stop Motion: One Frame at a Time
items.summary: Stop motion is a test of stability: lock the camera, lock the light, move the puppet a little each frame. Two seconds in a day is normal. You are not slow.

items.title: 定格运动模糊：拍两遍
items.summary: 定格运动模糊靠两次曝光或后期合成，不是把帧率调低。

items.title: Stop-Motion Motion Blur: Shoot It Twice
items.summary: Stop-motion blur comes from double exposure or post compositing, not a lower frame rate.

items.title: 定格布景：尺度与透视线
items.summary: 定格布景先定人偶比例，再按镜头透视做大小；比例错了，怎么打光都假。

items.title: Stop-Motion Set: Scale and Perspective
items.summary: Set puppet scale first, then build to camera perspective. Wrong scale looks fake in any light.

items.title: 动画的时间感：两张原画之间，决定重量
items.summary: 一个球从桌上掉下来，画几张中间帧、每张隔多远，观众就能感觉到它是乒乓球还是铅球。

items.title: Timing in Animation: The Weight Lives Between Two Keys
items.summary: A ball falls off a table. How many in-betweens you draw, and how far apart they sit, tells the audience whether it is a ping-pong ball or a shot put.

items.title: 产品广告：三秒抓人，十秒讲清
items.summary: 产品广告不是产品展示片。前三秒给问题，中段给一个卖点，结尾给一个动作。

items.title: Product Ad: Hook in Three Seconds, Explain in Ten
items.summary: A product ad is not a product showcase. Give a problem in three seconds, one benefit in the middle, one action at the end.

items.title: 品牌片拉片：90 秒怎么建立世界
items.summary: 按 90 秒品牌片的通用结构，拆 9 个时间码：世界、人物、欲望、阻碍、转向、行动、落点、一句话、停留。

items.title: Brand Film Breakdown: Build a World in Ninety Seconds
items.summary: A nine-beat breakdown of a ninety-second brand film: world, character, want, obstacle, turn, action, resolve, line, hold.

items.title: 品牌片模板：主张、证据、落点
items.summary: 品牌片模板立场、证据、落点；立场要能被反对，证据要具体。

items.title: Brand Film Template: Stance, Evidence, Landing
items.summary: Stance, evidence, landing. The stance must be arguable and the evidence concrete.

items.title: 品牌片：先让人相信一句话
items.summary: 品牌片不解释参数，它让观众记住一个态度。产品只是证据，不是主角。

items.title: Brand Film: Make Them Believe One Sentence
items.summary: A brand film does not explain specs; it leaves one attitude. The product is evidence, not the protagonist.

items.title: 企业宣传拉片：六个段落怎么落地
items.summary: 综合样例：把企业宣传拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

items.title: Corporate Video Breakdown: Six Beats in Practice
items.summary: Composite sample: break corporate video into six beats and read picture, sound, and the pass line beat by beat; illustrative numbers are not client data.

items.title: 企业宣传结构：六个拍点
items.summary: 企业宣传不是公司简介视频。先写一个观众愿意看完的问题，再用一个人、一个动作证明公司解决了它。

items.title: Corporate Video Structure: Six Beats
items.summary: Corporate video is not a company profile. Write a question the viewer wants answered, then prove with one person and one action that the company solves it.

items.title: 企业宣传模板：一张表拍完
items.summary: 企业宣传一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。

items.title: Corporate Video Template: One Sheet to Shoot
items.summary: A one-sheet corporate video plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

items.title: 纪录短片：拍到一个变化
items.summary: 先找到一个人，再等一件事发生。片子成立，往往是因为开机前后他变了点什么。

items.title: Documentary Short: Capture a Change
items.summary: Find one person, then wait for one thing to happen. The film usually works because something changed between the first day and the last.

items.title: 纪录短片拉片：一个人、一件事、一个变化
items.summary: 按 3 分钟纪录短片的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：动作、人物、欲望、阻碍、尝试、代价、变化、之后。

items.title: Documentary Breakdown: One Person, One Event, One Change
items.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a three-minute documentary: action, person, want, obstacle, attempt, cost, change, after.

items.title: 纪录模板：一个人、一件事、一个变化
items.summary: 纪录模板一个人、一件具体的事、一个能看见的变化；不要从时代开始讲。

items.title: Documentary Template: One Person, One Thing, One Change
items.summary: One person, one concrete task, one visible change. Do not start with an era.

items.title: 竖屏短剧：前三秒先让人物要东西
items.summary: 竖屏没有时间铺世界。第一屏让人物想要一个东西，第三秒让观众知道谁挡着，最后留一个没答的问题。

items.title: Vertical Drama: A Want in the First Three Seconds
items.summary: Vertical drama has no time for a world. Put a want in the first frame, an obstacle by the third second, and leave one question unanswered.

items.title: 活动片拉片：90 秒怎么讲清现场
items.summary: 按 90 秒活动片的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：到场、规模、关键瞬间、细节、人、高潮、之后、落版。

items.title: Event Breakdown: Make a Live Event Clear in Ninety Seconds
items.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a ninety-second event film: arrival, scale, key moment, detail, people, climax, aftermath, end card.

items.title: 活动片结构：先给结果，再给过程
items.summary: 活动片先给结果，再给过程；观众要知道这场活动成了什么。

items.title: Event Film Structure: Result First, Process Second
items.summary: Result first, process second; the viewer needs to know what the event became.

items.title: 活动片模板：开场、现场、收束
items.summary: 活动片模板开场、现场、收束；现场段落要有环境声，不要全铺音乐。

items.title: Event Template: Open, Live, Close

items.title: Experimental Structure: Rules Before Effects

items.title: Fashion & Beauty Structure: Six Beats
items.summary: Fashion and beauty is not a runway clip. Define texture first—fabric, skin, light—and prove it with close-ups and action, not a beauty filter.

items.title: Food & Table Structure: Six Beats
items.summary: Food video is not a rotating platter. Shoot change: raw to cooked, cold to hot, whole to cut. Sound is the second dish; hands persuade more than words.

items.summary: A one-sheet food & table plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

items.title: Interview Structure: The Question Matters More
items.summary: The question matters more than the camera; a vague question gets a vague answer.

items.summary: 访谈模板人物、问题、场景；先拍他能做事的地方，再坐下来讲。

items.title: Interview Template: Person, Question, Scene
items.summary: Person, question, scene. Shoot where they act before sitting them down.

items.title: Live & Podcast Structure: Six Beats
items.summary: Live/podcast is not uploading a long video. Design cuttable units: one complete question every 3–5 minutes so a viewer entering late still understands.

items.title: Music Video Breakdown: Map Song Structure to Image
items.summary: A nine-beat breakdown of a three-and-a-half-minute music video: intro motif, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, verse two, bridge, final chorus, outro, hold.

items.title: MV 结构：歌是时间轴
items.summary: MV 结构跟歌走：主歌给空间，副歌给记忆点，桥段给转折。

items.title: Music Video Structure: The Song Is the Timeline
items.summary: Follow the song: verses give space, chorus gives a memory image, bridge gives the turn.

items.title: MV 模板：主歌、副歌、记忆点
items.summary: MV 模板主歌、副歌、记忆点；记忆点可以是一个动作或一个画面。

items.title: Music Video Template: Verse, Chorus, Memory
items.summary: Verse, chorus, memory. The memory can be one action or one image.

items.title: News Breakdown: Keep the Unknown in Ninety Seconds
items.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a ninety-second news feature: verified fact, scene, witness, archive, context, known/unknown, unresolved, next.

items.title: News Structure: Scene First, Verification Second
items.summary: Scene first, verification second. Background first loses the viewer.

items.summary: 新闻模板现场、背景、影响；每一段都要回答一个观众的问题。

items.title: News Template: Scene, Context, Impact
items.summary: Scene, context, impact; each section answers one viewer question.

items.summary: 产品广告模板前三秒给问题，十秒给证明，最后五秒给一个动作。

items.title: Product Ad Template: Three Seconds of Problem, Ten of Proof
items.summary: Three seconds of problem, ten of proof, five of action.

items.title: 封面缩到 200 像素，还认得出吗
items.summary: 手机上的封面只有拇指大。先保证一张脸、一个动作、一个对比，再谈字。

items.title: Does the Cover Still Read at 200 Pixels?
items.summary: On a phone, a cover is the size of a thumb. Secure one face, one action, one contrast before adding type.

items.summary: 综合样例：把房产空间拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

items.summary: 房产片不是广角扫楼。先给“谁住进来”的生活问题，再用空间证明；每个镜头回答一个居住问题。

items.title: Real Estate & Space Structure: Six Beats
items.summary: Real-estate video is not a wide-angle building tour. Start with the life problem of who lives here, then prove it with space; every shot answers one living question.

items.title: Short Drama Breakdown: One Turn in Thirty Seconds
items.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a thirty-second short drama: image hook, claim, setup, escalation, false answer, clue, turn, reaction.

items.title: 短剧模板：30 秒一个钩子
items.summary: 短剧模板每三十秒一个钩子：新信息、新阻碍、新代价。

items.summary: A hook every thirty seconds: new information, new obstacle, new cost.

items.summary: 综合样例：把运动短片拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

items.title: Sports Film Breakdown: Six Beats in Practice
items.summary: Composite sample: break sports film into six beats and read picture, sound, and the pass line beat by beat; illustrative numbers are not client data.

items.title: 运动短片结构：六个拍点
items.summary: 运动短片不是慢动作集锦。先定一个动作目标：赢、复出、还是接受失败；让身体承担叙事，不靠旁白解释。

items.title: Sports Film Structure: Six Beats
items.summary: A sports film is not a slow-motion highlight. Set one physical goal—win, return, or accept failure—and let the body carry the story.

items.title: 运动短片模板：一张表拍完
items.summary: 运动短片一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。
