items.summary: A one-sheet sports film plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

items.title: 口播：写给耳朵，不是写给眼睛
items.summary: 口播不是把文章念出来。观众听不见标点，只听得见意思。句子要短，转折要早，例子要具体；一口气说不完，就分成两句。

items.title: Talking Head: Write for the Ear
items.summary: A talking-head piece is not an article read aloud. The viewer cannot hear punctuation, only meaning. Keep sentences short, turn early, use concrete examples; if it cannot be said in one breath, split it.

items.title: 口播拉片：60 秒怎么留住人
items.summary: 按 60 秒口播的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：结论、原因、例子一、例子二、反方、证据、应用、问题。

items.title: Talking Head Breakdown: Hold Attention for Sixty Seconds
items.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a sixty-second talking head: claim, reason, example one, example two, counter, proof, application, question.

items.title: 口播模板：一句话、三个例子、一个动作
items.summary: 口播模板一句话主张、三个例子、一个动作；例子必须能被镜头看见。

items.title: Talking Head Template: One Claim, Three Proofs, One Action
items.summary: One claim, three proofs, one action; every proof must be visible on camera.

items.title: 教程拉片：5 分钟怎么让人学会
items.summary: 按 5 分钟教程的通用结构，拆 10 个时间码：结果、材料、三步、检查、失败、复盘、下一步、行动。

items.title: Tutorial Breakdown: Teach in Five Minutes
items.summary: A ten-beat breakdown of a five-minute tutorial: result, materials, three steps, check, failure, recap, next, action.

items.title: 教程结构：一个问题只教一件事
items.summary: 教程结构一个问题只教一件事；塞进三个技巧，观众一个也学不会。

items.title: Tutorial Structure: One Problem, One Skill
items.summary: One problem, one skill. Three tricks in one tutorial means none is learned.

items.title: 教程模板：目标、步骤、验收
items.summary: 教程模板目标、步骤、验收；每一步都要有可观察的结果。

items.title: Tutorial Template: Goal, Steps, Check
items.summary: Goal, steps, check; every step needs an observable result.

items.title: Vlog 拉片：90 秒一个发现
items.summary: 按 90 秒旅拍 Vlog 的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：动作、地点、任务、阻碍、失败、发现、安静、离开。

items.title: Vlog Breakdown: One Discovery in Ninety Seconds
items.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a ninety-second travel vlog: action, place, task, obstacle, failure, discovery, quiet, exit.

items.title: 旅拍 Vlog 结构：先给一个地方的理由
items.summary: 旅拍 Vlog 先给一个去这里的理由，再拍好看；没有理由，风景只是屏保。

items.title: Vlog Structure: Give the Place a Reason
items.summary: Give the place a reason before making it pretty; without reason, scenery is a screensaver.

items.title: Vlog 模板：出发、遇到、改变
items.summary: Vlog 模板出发、遇到、改变；改变可以很小，但必须发生。

items.title: Vlog Template: Go, Meet, Change
items.summary: Go, meet, change. The change can be small, but it must happen.

items.title: 婚礼拉片：6 分钟怎么不拍成流程
items.summary: 按 6 分钟婚礼片的通用结构，拆 11 个时间码：准备、到场、仪式、誓言、戒指、家人、宴会、舞会、安静、肖像、离开。

items.title: Wedding Breakdown: Six Minutes Without a Checklist
items.summary: An eleven-beat breakdown of a six-minute wedding film: prep, arrival, ceremony, vows, rings, family, reception, dance, quiet, portraits, exit.

items.title: 婚礼片结构：先保仪式，再谈风格
items.summary: 婚礼片先保仪式和誓言，再谈慢动作和调色；仪式没拍到，风格救不回来。

items.title: Wedding Film Structure: Ceremony Before Style
items.summary: Protect ceremony and vows before slow motion and grading; style cannot save a missed ritual.

items.title: 婚礼模板：开场、仪式、祝福
items.summary: 婚礼模板开场、仪式、祝福；开场给一天的感觉，不是给婚纱特写。

items.title: Wedding Template: Opening, Ceremony, Blessing
items.summary: Opening, ceremony, blessing. The opening gives the day, not a dress close-up.

items.title: 录音入门：话筒位置比设备贵更重要
items.summary: 同一支便宜话筒，放在离嘴 20 厘米的位置，通常比一万元设备放在机顶更好。

items.title: Audio Basics: Mic Position Beats Price
items.summary: A cheap mic twenty centimeters from the mouth usually beats an expensive rig mounted on the camera.

items.title: 相机怎么选：先看约束，不看品牌
items.summary: 先写你拍什么、在哪拍、给谁看、能背多重，再选机身。参数表不能替你做决定。

items.title: How to Choose a Camera: Constraints Before Brands
items.summary: Write what you shoot, where, for whom, and how much you can carry before choosing a body. A spec sheet cannot decide for you.

items.title: 交付：别在最后导错文件
items.summary: 交付不是点导出。先问平台要什么：比例、分辨率、帧率、码率、色彩、声道、文件名。做一个能重复的模板，交付前自己从头播一遍。

items.title: Delivery: Find the Wrong Export Before the Last Hour
items.summary: Delivery is not hitting export. Ask what the platform needs: ratio, resolution, frame rate, bitrate, color, channels, filename. Build a template you can repeat, then watch the file from start to finish.

items.title: 发布前 12 项检查：别在最后一小时翻车
items.summary: 授权、技术、发布三组检查。每一项都能在十分钟内查完，别等到上传后才看到黑帧和错字。

items.title: Twelve Checks Before Publishing: Do Not Lose the Last Hour
items.summary: Three groups of checks: rights, technical, and publishing. Each takes ten minutes; do not discover a black frame or a typo after upload.

items.title: 底噪排查：从房间开始
items.summary: 底噪排查从房间开始：关空调、关灯、换插座、换线；最后才怪麦克风。

items.title: Audio Noise Fix: Start With the Room
items.summary: Start with the room: air conditioning, lights, outlet, cable; blame the mic last.

items.title: 预算与报价：把风险写进数字
items.summary: 预算不是成本清单，是把“会停拍的那一项”先保住。报价不是成本加 20%，是把范围、修改、授权和风险分别定价。

items.title: Budget and Quote: Put Risk into the Number
items.summary: A budget is not a cost list; it protects the line that would stop the shoot. A quote is not cost plus 20%; it prices scope, revisions, rights, and risk separately.

items.title: 现场录音机：通道、32 位浮点与时码
items.summary: 现场录音机的核心不是“能录几轨”，而是“断了一个通道还有没有备份、增益错了能不能救、后期能不能对时码”。

items.title: Field Recorder: Channels, 32-bit Float, and Timecode
items.summary: A field recorder is not about track count. It is about whether one lost channel has a backup, a wrong gain can be saved, and post can sync to timecode.

items.title: 先买录音：麦克风、底噪与增益
items.summary: 观众能忍画面普通，忍不了声音听不清。预算有限时，先把钱放在麦克风和录音机，而不是第二支镜头。

items.title: Buy Audio First: Mic, Noise Floor, and Gain
items.summary: Audiences forgive a plain image; they do not forgive unclear sound. On a limited budget, put money into a microphone and recorder before a second lens.

items.title: 购买电池：容量、通信与安全
items.summary: 电池不是“能开机就行”。副厂电池可能不显示电量、突然掉电、胀包；拍一天项目，电池是安全件，不是省钱件。

items.title: Buying Batteries: Capacity, Communication, and Safety
items.summary: A battery is not “it powers on.” Third-party packs may hide percentage, cut out, or swell. On a shoot day, batteries are safety equipment, not a place to save.

items.title: 购买相机：先定预算，再定机身
items.summary: 预算有限时，机身不是第一优先级。先确认你缺的是暗光、自动对焦、10-bit、还是收音；买错机身，后面每一件配件都要跟着换。

items.title: Buying a Camera: Budget Before Body
items.summary: On a limited budget, the body is not first. Find whether you lack low light, autofocus, 10-bit, or audio. The wrong body forces every accessory to change with it.

items.title: 购买电影机：别把“能拍”当成“能交”
items.summary: 电影机的价格不只在机身：卡、电池、监看、底座、提手、线材、调色和学习都要算。先确认项目真的需要 RAW、时码、SDI 和双卡，否则一台高端视频机更划算。

items.title: Buying a Cinema Camera: “Can Shoot” Is Not “Can Deliver”
items.summary: A cinema camera’s price is not the body: cards, batteries, monitoring, rig, handles, cables, grading, and learning all count. Confirm the project needs RAW, timecode, SDI, and dual card, or a high-end video body is better value.

items.title: 第一台稳定器：承重、调平与跟随
items.summary: 稳定器不是“走路不抖”的魔法。承重余量、三轴调平、跟随手感、电池和轴锁，决定你能不能用它拍完一个镜头。

items.title: Your First Gimbal: Payload, Balance, and Follow
items.summary: A gimbal is not magic for walking. Payload headroom, three-axis balance, follow feel, battery, and axis locks decide whether you can finish a shot.

items.title: 先买镜头：焦段、光圈与呼吸
items.summary: 镜头决定画面的一半，而且比机身保值。先买一支能覆盖 70% 场景的焦段，再买第二支；不要一开始凑三支便宜变焦。

items.title: Buy the Lens First: Focal Length, Aperture, Breathing
items.summary: The lens decides half the image and holds value better than a body. Buy one focal length that covers 70% of your work, then a second; do not start with three cheap zooms.

items.title: 购买变焦：齐焦、呼吸与伺服
items.summary: 变焦的价值是“不换镜”，不是“什么都能拍”。先确认它在推拉时能保住焦点、呼吸不明显、伺服不吵；否则你买的是一支会变焦的定焦。

items.title: Buying a Zoom: Parfocal, Breathing, and Servo
items.summary: A zoom buys “no lens change,” not “anything.” Confirm it holds focus through the zoom, breathing is controlled, and the servo is quiet; otherwise you bought a prime that can change focal length.

items.title: 购买灯光套装：先买柔，再买亮
items.summary: 第一套灯不是最亮的，是最容易控制肤色和阴影的。柔光面积、色温一致、可调功率，比峰值亮度更重要。

items.title: Buying a Light Kit: Soft Before Bright
items.summary: The first light kit is not the brightest; it is the easiest to control skin and shadow. Soft area, consistent color, and dimmability matter more than peak output.

items.title: 购买 LED 灯：亮度、频闪与供电
items.summary: LED 的参数不只是瓦数。频闪、色温偏移、电池续航、DMX/无线控制，决定它能不能在真实拍摄现场稳定工作。

items.title: Buying LED Lights: Output, Flicker, and Power
items.summary: LED specs are not just wattage. Flicker, color shift, battery runtime, and DMX/wireless control decide whether it works on a real set.

items.title: 购买监视器：亮度、色域与延迟
items.summary: 监视器不是“外接大屏”。现场要亮到看得见、色彩要能校准、延迟要能对焦；三项任何一项不够，都还不如机头屏。

items.title: Buying a Monitor: Brightness, Gamut, and Latency
items.summary: A monitor is not a bigger screen. It must be bright enough outdoors, calibratable, and low-latency for focus; if one fails, the camera screen is better.

items.title: 购买 HDR 监视器：峰值亮度不是全部
items.summary: HDR 监看要看峰值、黑位、色域、色调映射和校准。只看“1000 nit”会买到一台高亮但高光全糊的屏。

items.title: Buying an HDR Monitor: Peak Nits Is Not Everything
items.summary: HDR monitoring depends on peak, black level, gamut, tone mapping, and calibration. Buying on “1000 nits” alone gets a bright screen with clipped highlights.

items.title: 购买 NAS/RAID：吞吐、重建与噪声
items.summary: NAS 不是“插上就安全”。RAID 不是备份；重建期间性能会掉，劵盘/静音/功耗都会影响工作室。先算吞吐和重建时间。

items.title: Buying NAS/RAID: Throughput, Rebuild, and Noise
items.summary: NAS is not “plug in and safe.” RAID is not backup; rebuilds slow everything, and drive noise/power affect a studio. Calculate throughput and rebuild time first.

items.title: 购买项目存储：速度、容量与备份
items.summary: 存储不是“越大越好”，是“拍摄不断、拷回不丢、项目结束还能找得到”。先算一个项目日的真实数据量，再买盘。

items.title: Buying Project Storage: Speed, Capacity, and Backup
items.summary: Storage is not “bigger is better.” It is “the shoot does not stop, the offload does not lose data, and the project is findable later.” Calculate a real shoot day before buying.

items.title: 购买存储卡：VPG、持续写入与发热
items.summary: 卡的标称读取速度没有意义，持续写入才决定会不会丢帧。先看相机要求的最小持续写入，再买高一档的卡，并至少两张轮换。

items.title: Buying Camera Cards: VPG, Sustained Write, and Heat
items.summary: A card’s peak read speed is irrelevant; sustained write decides whether frames drop. Match the camera’s minimum sustained write, buy one step above, and rotate at least two cards.

items.title: 购买时码器：漂移、同步与电池
items.summary: 时码器不是“多机位一定需要”，但一旦需要，漂移和同步稳定性比外观重要。先测 8 小时漂移，再决定买几台。

items.title: Buying Timecode: Drift, Sync, and Battery
items.summary: Timecode is not automatic for multicam, but when needed, drift and sync stability matter more than looks. Test eight-hour drift before deciding how many units.

items.title: 购买三脚架：承重、扭转与高度
items.summary: 三脚架的标称承重不是安全线。真正决定稳定性的是脚管刚度、云台锁紧、扭转刚度和重心；风一吹就晃的架子，承重写 20kg 也没用。

items.title: Buying a Tripod: Payload, Torsion, and Height
items.summary: A tripod’s payload rating is not a safety line. Leg stiffness, head lock, torsional rigidity, and centre of gravity decide stability; a flexy tripod rated 20kg still shakes in wind.

items.title: 购买液压云台：阻尼、平衡与回弹
items.summary: 液压云台不是“能转就行”。真正的差别在俯仰阻尼是否连续、重心平衡是否够、松手后是否匀速回弹；这些决定你能否拍出稳定的摇移。

items.title: Buying a Fluid Head: Drag, Counterbalance, and Return
items.summary: A fluid head is not “it pans.” The difference is continuous tilt drag, enough counterbalance, and a smooth return when released; these decide whether your pan/tilt is usable.

items.title: 购买二手器材：快门、传感器与维修
items.summary: 二手不是“便宜”，是“把风险折成价格”。先查快门/传感器/接口/维修记录，再谈价；没有试拍和退货条款，再便宜也不要。

items.title: Buying Used Gear: Shutter, Sensor, and Service
items.summary: Used is not “cheap”; it is risk priced in. Check shutter, sensor, ports, and service history before negotiating. Without a test shoot and return terms, walk away.

items.title: 购买无线领夹：距离、断点与延迟
items.summary: 无线领夹的“500 米”是空旷视距，不是商场/演唱会。先测你真实场景的断点、底噪、延迟和电池，再决定买哪一套。

items.title: Buying Wireless Lavs: Range, Dropouts, and Latency
items.summary: A “500m” wireless lav range is open line-of-sight, not a mall or concert. Test dropouts, noise, latency, and battery in your real scene before choosing.

items.title: 剧组管理：通告、签到、收工与责任
items.summary: 剧组管理不是发通告，是让每个人知道今天做什么、出事找谁、什么时候能走。通告单、签到、收工报告三张纸决定项目是否可控。

items.title: Crew Management: Call Sheet, Sign-In, Wrap, and Ownership
items.summary: Crew management is not sending a call sheet. It makes everyone know the day, the owner of each risk, and when they can leave. Call sheet, sign-in, and wrap report make a project controllable.

items.title: 导出失败排查：编码、磁盘、权限
items.summary: 导出失败先查编码、磁盘空间、权限；三样都排除，再重建项目。

items.title: Export Failure Fix: Codec, Disk, Permission
items.summary: Check codec, disk space, and permissions; only then rebuild the project.

items.title: 果冻效应：读速与快门
items.summary: 果冻效应来自慢读出和快速运动；先换机器，再调快门，别只怪镜头。

items.title: Jelly Effect Fix: Read Speed and Shutter
items.summary: Rolling shutter comes from slow readout and fast motion; change body or shutter before blaming the lens.

items.title: 相机过热：降温与分段拍
items.summary: 相机过热先降温、分段拍、降码率；不要用湿毛巾直接敷机身。

items.title: Overheating Fix: Cool, Segment, Lower Bitrate
items.summary: Cool it, shoot in segments, lower bitrate; do not put a wet towel on the body.

items.title: 租相机：保险、押金、检查
items.summary: 租相机先买保险、交押金、当面检查；划痕和坏点拍视频留证。

items.title: Renting a Camera: Insurance, Deposit, Check
items.summary: Insurance, deposit, and a hands-on check; film scratches and dead pixels as evidence.

items.title: 灯光租赁：清单与损坏
items.summary: 灯光租赁先列清单、试亮、拍损坏；少一个灯罩，现场就得多等一小时。

items.title: Renting Lighting: List and Damage
items.summary: List, test, and photograph the gear; one missing soft box costs an hour on set.

items.title: 二手器材检查：快门、卡口、传感器
items.summary: 二手器材检查快门数、卡口松动、传感器坏点；三项都过再付钱。

items.title: Used Gear Check: Shutter, Mount, Sensor
items.summary: Check shutter count, mount play, and sensor dead pixels before paying.

items.title: 预算里留 10%，给意外留个座位
items.summary: 天气、场地超时、补拍、临时加人，这四件事几乎每次都会发生。预算表上没有它们，超支就会从别的地方偷。

items.title: Hold Ten Percent for the Unexpected
items.summary: Weather, overtime, reshoots, and last-minute hires happen on almost every shoot. If they are not in the budget, the overrun steals from somewhere else.

items.title: 预算表：把钱分成四块
items.summary: 预算不是一列数字，是四块怎么分：必须花的、会上镜的、能替换的、会爆的。先保片子能拍完，再谈好看。

items.title: Budget: Four Buckets, One Decision
items.summary: A budget is not a column of numbers. It is four buckets: what must be paid, what will be seen, what can be swapped, and what will blow up. Keep the film shootable before you make it pretty.

items.title: 通告单：一张纸，把今天说清
items.summary: 通告单不是形式。它决定谁几点到、去哪、带什么、找谁。写不清，现场的电话就会比拍摄还忙。

items.title: Call Sheet: One Page, One Plan
items.summary: A call sheet is not paperwork. It decides who arrives when, where, with what, and whom to call. If it is vague, the set fills with phone calls and the day slows down.

items.title: 选人：先站得住，再看戏
items.summary: 选演员不是找最会演的，是找最适合这段关系的人。先看外形和声音是否成立，再看两个人站在一起有没有事，最后才看台词。试读给一个动作，不给一段独白。

items.title: Casting: Can They Stand in the Room Before They Can Act?
items.summary: Casting is not finding the best actor. It is finding the person who fits this relationship. Check whether the look and voice hold, then whether two people have something between them, and only then the lines. Give an action in the audition, not a monologue.

items.title: 场地：开拍前先问清五件事
items.summary: 场地不是“看起来合适”就能拍。谁有权答应、邻居会不会投诉、电从哪来、声音收不收得住、出了问题谁赔，五件事任何一件没问清，现场都可能停。

items.title: Location: Five Questions Before You Unpack
items.summary: A location is not a place that looks right. Who can say yes, who will complain, where the power comes from, what the sound does, and who pays for damage: miss one and the day stops.

items.title: 拍摄日程：把剧本拆成条
items.summary: 排期不是把场景按顺序填进日历。先按地点和人物拆条，再按天分组；同一天只搬一次家，演员只来一次。日程保护的不是进度，是表演。

items.title: Stripboard: Turn the Script into Shootable Days
items.summary: Scheduling is not filling the calendar in script order. Break the script into strips by location and cast, then group them into days: one company move, one actor call. The schedule protects the performance, not just the progress.

items.title: 提案：先让人看见片子
items.summary: 提案不是把剧本换成漂亮话，是让客户在开机前看见片子的样子、语气和边界。

items.title: Treatment: Make the Film Visible on Paper
items.summary: A treatment does not decorate a script; it lets the client see the film's shape, tone, and limits before the shoot.

items.title: 3-2-1 备份：当天做完
items.summary: 3-2-1 备份当天做完：三份、两种介质、一份异地；拖到明天，素材就可能没了。

items.title: 3-2-1 Backup: Finish It Today
items.summary: Do 3-2-1 today: three copies, two media, one offsite; tomorrow the card may be gone.

items.title: 吊杆移动：跟着台词走
items.summary: 吊杆跟着演员胸口走，不跟着嘴；嘴会转，胸口不会突然消失。

items.title: Boom Swing: Follow the Chest
items.summary: Follow the chest, not the mouth; the mouth turns, the chest stays in range.

items.title: 相机黑平衡：别把噪点当风格
items.summary: 相机黑平衡按机器要求做，别把噪点当风格；暗部干净，后期才有空间。

items.title: Camera Black Balance: Do Not Bake Noise
items.summary: Black balance as the camera requires; do not bake noise into the look. Clean shadows give post room.

items.title: 色卡拍摄：后期对色
items.summary: 色卡在场景光下拍一张，后期才有基准；开机后补拍，光已经变了。

items.title: Color Checker: Shoot It Before the Scene
items.summary: Shoot the chart under scene light before the take; after the first setup, the light has changed.

items.title: 双系统合板：拍手与时间码
items.summary: 双系统合板先拍手，再对时间码；两条都对上，后期才不用逐条听。

items.title: Dual-System Sync: Clap and Timecode
items.summary: Clap first, then timecode; when both match, post does not have to listen to every take.

items.title: H.264 导出：码率与兼容
items.summary: H.264 导出先定平台和码率，再选两遍编码；码率太低，运动画面先烂。

items.title: H.264 Export: Bitrate and Compatibility
items.summary: Set platform and bitrate before two-pass encoding; low bitrate destroys motion first.

items.title: ProRes 导出：归档与交付
items.summary: ProRes 用于归档和再调色，不是给所有平台直接上传；文件大，但能再改。

items.title: ProRes Export: Archive and Delivery
items.summary: ProRes is for archive and regrading, not direct upload everywhere; big files, but editable.

items.title: 开机曝光检查：波形、斑马、假色
items.summary: 开机曝光检查按顺序：波形看分布、斑马看高光、伪色看人脸；三个都过再开拍。

items.title: Exposure Check: Waveform, Zebra, False Color
items.summary: Check exposure in order: waveform for distribution, zebra for highlights, false color for skin; roll only after all three.

items.title: 跟焦练习：三步走
items.summary: 跟焦练习三步：先做标记、盯住演员的胸口、呼吸别跟着手抖。

items.title: Follow Focus Practice: Mark, Watch, Breathe
items.summary: Three steps: mark the barrel, watch the chest, and keep breathing steady.

items.title: 稳定器调平：开机前五分钟
items.summary: 稳定器调平按三轴依次做，每次锁轴再调下一轴；开机前五分钟，省现场半小时。

items.title: Gimbal Balance: Five Minutes Before Power
items.summary: Balance each axis with the others locked; five minutes before power saves half an hour on set.

items.title: 手持支撑：三个接触点
items.summary: 手持支撑找三个接触点：胸口、肩膀、手肘；三点稳定，画面才不像地震。

items.title: Handheld Brace: Three Contact Points
items.summary: Find three contact points: chest, shoulder, elbow; three points stabilize the frame.

items.title: 领夹藏麦：衣领、头发、胶带
items.summary: 领夹藏麦先试衣领，再试头发，最后用医用胶带固定；每换一件衣服都要重藏。

items.title: Lav Hiding: Collar, Hair, Tape
items.summary: Try collar, then hair, then medical tape; every wardrobe change needs a new hide.

items.title: 单灯人像：先有方向
items.summary: 单灯人像先定方向：45 度、侧光还是逆光；方向对了，再谈柔硬和亮度。

items.title: One-Light Portrait: Direction First
items.summary: Set direction first: 45 degrees, side, or backlight; then softness and intensity.

items.title: 窗光补光：反光板位置
items.summary: 窗光补光把反光板放在阴影侧，别放在窗边；反光板是补暗，不是加亮。

items.title: Window Light Fill: Reflector Placement
items.summary: Place the reflector on the shadow side, not by the window; it fills shadow, not adds light.

items.title: ND 计算：大光圈白天怎么曝光
items.summary: ND 计算先定快门和光圈，再算需要减几档；凭感觉换滤镜，十次有九次过暗。

items.title: ND Calculation: Wide Open in Daylight
items.summary: Set shutter and aperture, then calculate stops; guessing the filter leaves you dark nine times out of ten.

items.title: 夜景实用光：曝光平衡
items.summary: 夜景实用光先让画面里的灯成立，再用小灯补人脸；两者亮度差太多，就会假。

items.title: Night Practical: Balance the Lamp
items.summary: Make the lamp in frame believable, then add a small face light; a big ratio looks fake.

items.title: 代理生成：剪辑不卡
items.summary: 代理按时间线和交付分辨率生成，别用完整分辨率硬剪；代理不对，字幕和构图会错。

items.title: Proxy Creation: Match the Timeline
items.summary: Generate proxies to match timeline and delivery; full-res editing makes subtitles and framing wrong.

items.title: 恢复演练：随机抽一个文件
items.summary: 恢复演练随机抽一个文件，从备份打开；打不开的备份等于没有。

items.title: Restore Test: Pick One Random File
items.summary: Restore one random file from backup; a backup that will not open does not exist.

items.title: 环境音录制：三十秒规则
items.summary: 每个场景录三十秒环境声，全组安静；没有它，剪对话会像在真空里。

items.title: Room Tone: Thirty Seconds per Location
items.summary: Record thirty seconds of room tone per location with everyone quiet; without it, dialogue cuts sound like a vacuum.

items.title: 素材车：现场拷卡与命名
items.summary: 素材车现场拷卡、校验、命名、备份；回机房再整理，时间会翻倍。

items.title: Media Bay: Offload and Name on Set
items.summary: Offload, verify, name, and back up on set; organizing later doubles the time.

items.title: 滑轨起停：让运动有头尾
items.summary: 滑轨镜头要有头、身、尾：起幅停半秒、过程匀、落幅停半秒。

items.title: Slider Shot: Head, Body, Tail
items.summary: A slider shot needs a head, body, and tail: hold the start, move evenly, hold the end.

items.title: SRT 字幕：编码、时间轴、标点
items.summary: SRT 字幕先保 UTF-8 编码、时间轴和标点；编码错了，平台会显示乱码。

items.title: SRT Subtitles: Encoding, Timing, Punctuation
items.summary: SRT needs UTF-8, timing, and punctuation; wrong encoding shows garbage on platform.

items.title: 多机位同步：时间码与手动
items.summary: 多机位同步先对时间码，再用拍手兜底；两样都做，剪辑才敢切。

items.title: Multicam Sync: Timecode and Clap
items.summary: Sync timecode first, clap as backup; with both, the edit can cut confidently.

items.title: 灰卡白平衡：混合光怎么对
items.summary: 灰卡白平衡解决混合光下的中性；先把灰卡放到主体位置，再读。

items.title: Gray Card White Balance: Mixed Light
items.summary: A gray card neutralizes mixed light; place it where the subject stands before reading.

items.title: 第一次开机，先把这 6 件事写下来
items.summary: 第一次拍片，现场最容易乱的就是时间、地点、谁负责、先拍什么、备用方案和收工标准。写在一页纸上，比脑子里记靠谱。

items.title: Six Things to Write Down Before Your First Shoot Day
items.summary: First shoots fall apart around time, place, ownership, shot order, backups, and when to stop. Put all six on one page.

items.title: 素材管理：当天备份，命名可查
items.summary: 拍摄结束前做完备份，文件名带日期、场次、机位。找不到的素材等于没拍。

items.title: Media Management: Back Up Today, Name for Finding
items.summary: Back up before wrap. Put date, scene, and camera in the filename. Footage you cannot find was never shot.

items.title: AI 音频工具：授权与音质
items.summary: AI 音频工具先查授权和音质，再看功能；克隆声音的授权范围比音色重要。

items.title: AI Audio Tool: Rights and Quality
items.summary: Check rights and audio quality before features; a cloned voice's license matters more than timbre.

items.title: AI 视频工具：先看可控性
items.summary: AI 视频工具先看可控性：能不能锁角色、锁镜头、锁时长；只看样片会被骗。

items.title: AI Video Tool: Controllability First
items.summary: Check controllability: can it lock character, camera, duration? Demo reels lie.

items.title: 变形宽银幕：炫光与畸变
items.summary: 变形宽银幕不是把画面上下裁掉；它压缩横向、再还原，所以有椭圆光斑和独特畸变。

items.title: Anamorphic: Wide Screen, Not a Crop
items.summary: Anamorphic is not a top-and-bottom crop; it squeezes the image horizontally and restores it, giving oval bokeh and specific distortion.

items.title: 动画软件：2D、3D、定格
items.summary: 动画软件按工序选：2D 看绘图和合成，3D 看绑定和渲染，定格看拍摄控制；一个软件不可能全包。

items.title: Animation Software: 2D, 3D, Stop Motion
items.summary: Choose by pipeline: 2D for drawing and comp, 3D for rigging and render, stop motion for capture control.

items.title: 音频接口：输入与增益
items.summary: 音频接口先看输入数量、增益范围和底噪；接口再贵，增益不够也录不了小声。

items.title: Audio Interface: Inputs and Gain
items.summary: Check input count, gain range, and noise floor; a expensive interface with low gain cannot record a whisper.

items.title: CFexpress 卡：速度与发热
items.summary: CFexpress 卡先看持续写入和发热，不看峰值；拍长条时，热降速比容量更致命。

items.title: CFexpress: Speed and Heat
items.summary: Check sustained write and heat, not peak speed; on long takes, thermal throttling hurts before capacity.

items.title: 电影机：传感器、卡口、录制
items.summary: 电影机先看传感器、卡口和录制格式；名字和外形不决定它能不能拍你的项目。

items.title: Cine Camera: Sensor, Mount, Codec
items.summary: Cine cameras are sensor, mount, and codec first; the badge and body do not decide the job.

items.title: 云渲染：成本与传输
items.summary: 云渲染先算上传时间和出图成本；素材太大，上传比渲染更慢。

items.title: Cloud Render: Cost and Transfer
items.summary: Calculate upload time and output cost; with big media, upload is slower than render.

items.title: COB 灯：一盏灯加柔光箱
items.summary: COB 灯是裸光源，必须配柔光箱或灯笼；裸着照人脸，影子会硬得没法看。

items.title: COB Light: One Source, One Soft Box
items.summary: A COB is a bare source; pair it with a soft box or lantern or the face gets hard shadows.

items.title: 达芬奇节点：节点不是滤镜
items.summary: 节点不是滤镜叠叠乐；每个节点只做一件事，关掉它就能看出它干了什么。

items.title: DaVinci Nodes: Nodes Are Not Filters
items.summary: Nodes are not filter stacks; one node does one job, and disabling it reveals its effect.

items.title: 监视器：亮度、波形、LUT
items.summary: 现场监视器先看亮度、波形和 LUT；屏幕好看不代表素材对。

items.title: Field Monitor: Brightness, Scopes, LUT
items.summary: A field monitor needs brightness, scopes, and LUT support; a pretty screen does not mean correct footage.

items.title: 录音机：32-bit 浮点
items.summary: 32-bit 浮点录音能救回削波，但救不回被风吞掉的对白；麦克风和位置还是第一位。

items.title: Field Recorder: 32-Bit Is Not Magic
items.summary: 32-bit float can rescue clipping, not dialogue eaten by wind; mic and placement still come first.

items.title: 液压云台：三脚架怎么跟
items.summary: 液压云台的价值在阻尼：起停要顺，不能一碰就飞。

items.title: Fluid Head: Pan and Tilt Need Drag
items.summary: A fluid head is about drag: starts and stops must be smooth, not snappy.

items.title: 跟焦器：单手能跟
items.summary: 跟焦器让焦点变化有刻度、有手感；自动对焦在暗处和快速运动时不一定靠得住。

items.title: Follow Focus: One Hand Can Follow
items.summary: A follow focus gives marks and feel; autofocus is not reliable in darkness or fast motion.

items.title: 稳定器：平衡与步伐
items.summary: 稳定器先调平再开机；电机一直在救不平衡，画面就会抖，电池也撑不住。

items.title: Gimbal: Balance Before Power
items.summary: Balance the gimbal before powering up; motors fighting imbalance cause shake and battery drain.

items.title: 监听耳机：闭耳与漏音
items.summary: 监听耳机要封闭、贴合、不美化；用消费耳机监听，等于闭眼调色。

items.title: Monitoring Headphones: Closed, Sealed, Honest
items.summary: Monitoring headphones must be closed, sealed, and honest; consumer cans are color grading with eyes shut.

items.title: 无线领夹系统：频段与备份
items.summary: 无线领夹先查频段和干扰，再录一条备用轨；现场没有第二次机会。

items.title: Wireless Lav: Frequency and Backup
items.summary: Check frequency and interference, and record a backup track; the set gives no second chance.

items.title: LED 面板灯：显色与亮度
items.summary: LED 面板灯先看显色指数和实际亮度，不看包装上的瓦数；人脸发绿就是显色不对。

items.title: LED Panel: CRI and Brightness
items.summary: Check CRI and real output, not wattage on the box; green skin means the color is wrong.

items.title: 灯架与沙袋：安全第一
items.summary: 灯架先放沙袋，再升灯；一根没配重的灯架，倒下来比灯贵。

items.title: Light Stand: Sandbag Everything
items.summary: Sandbag the stand before raising the light; an unweighted stand costs more than the lamp when it falls.

items.title: LTO 归档：长期冷备
items.summary: LTO 适合长期冷备，不适合当天剪辑；先算恢复时间，再算每 TB 成本。

items.title: LTO Archive: Cold, Cheap, Slow
items.summary: LTO is for cold archive, not same-day editing; calculate restore time before cost per TB.

items.title: 遮光斗：滤镜与漏光
items.summary: 遮光斗先挡杂光，再装滤镜；便宜的遮光斗可能漏光，反而毁画面。

items.title: Matte Box: Filters and Stray Light
items.summary: A matte box cuts stray light before holding filters; a cheap one can leak and ruin the frame.

items.title: 微单拍视频：过热、果冻、裁切
items.summary: 微单拍视频先查三件事：会不会过热、果冻有多明显、录视频时裁不裁画幅。

items.title: Mirrorless for Video: Heat, Rolling Shutter, Crop
items.summary: Check three things: overheating, rolling shutter, and whether video crops the frame.

items.title: NAS：团队共享
items.summary: NAS 让全组共享素材，但必须先定命名、权限和回收站规则；否则共享等于互相覆盖。

items.title: NAS: Shared Storage, Shared Rules
items.summary: NAS shares media, so set naming, permissions, and trash rules first; otherwise sharing means overwriting.

items.title: 灯光色纸：CTO、CTB、ND
items.summary: 灯光色纸先分清 CTO、CTB、ND：一个加暖、一个加冷、一个减亮；贴错会改掉整个现场。

items.title: Lighting Gel: CTO, CTB, ND
items.summary: Know CTO, CTB, and ND: warm, cool, and dim. The wrong gel changes the whole set.

items.title: 剪辑软件怎么选：项目先定
items.summary: 剪辑软件按项目选：团队协作、代理、调色、字幕、交付，各有所长；别按教程数量选。

items.title: Choosing an NLE: Start With the Project
items.summary: Choose an NLE by project needs: collaboration, proxies, grading, subtitles, delivery; not by tutorial count.

items.title: 实用灯泡：色温与调光
items.summary: 实用灯泡要能调色温和亮度，否则画面里的灯只能当道具，不能当光源。

items.title: Practical Bulb: Color Temperature and Dimming
items.summary: A practical must dim and shift color temperature, or it is only a prop, not a source.

items.title: 定焦镜头：先走动，再变焦
items.summary: 定焦不是不能变焦，它逼你走近、退后、换机位；这通常比拧变焦环更有用。

items.title: Prime Lens: Move Your Feet
items.summary: A prime forces you to step in, back, and change position; that is often better than turning a zoom ring.

items.title: 反光板：五合一怎么用
items.summary: 反光板五合一不是五种风格，是五种补光强度；先用白色，别一上来就银面。

items.title: Reflector: Five Surfaces, One Job
items.summary: The five surfaces are five fill strengths, not five styles; start white, not silver.

items.title: 示波器监视：曝光与色彩
items.summary: 带示波器的监视器能同时看曝光和色彩；只看直方图，会漏掉肤色偏移。

items.title: Scope Monitor: Exposure and Color Together
items.summary: A scope monitor shows exposure and color together; a histogram alone misses skin drift.

items.title: 枪麦：指向性与离轴
items.summary: 枪麦是指向性工具，离得远就只能收环境；先靠近，再谈降噪。

items.title: Shotgun Mic: Point It, Get Close
items.summary: A shotgun is directional; distance gives you room, not dialogue. Get close before denoising.

items.title: 滑轨：起停与声音
items.summary: 滑轨最容易暴露起停：先慢起、匀走、缓停，别让轮子声进对白。

items.title: Slider: Start and Stop Quietly
items.summary: A slider exposes its start and stop; ease in, move evenly, ease out, and keep wheel noise off dialogue.

items.title: 柔光箱：尺寸决定柔度
items.summary: 柔光箱越大、越近，光越柔；换灯不如先把柔光箱靠近人物。

items.title: Softbox: Size Decides Softness
items.summary: Bigger and closer means softer; move the box before changing the light.

items.title: 增光减焦：画幅与光圈
items.summary: 增光减焦把全画幅镜头压到小画幅机身上，视角变宽、光圈约快一档，但边缘可能变软。

items.title: Speed Booster: Wider Angle, Faster Aperture
items.summary: A speed booster squeezes a full-frame lens onto a smaller sensor: wider view, about one stop faster, softer edges.

items.title: SSD RAID：剪辑阵列
items.summary: SSD RAID 是剪辑工作盘，不是归档；阵列一坏，重建比备份更贵。

items.title: SSD RAID: Edit Array, Not Archive
items.summary: SSD RAID is an edit workspace, not an archive; rebuilding costs more than backup.

items.title: 时间码：多机同步
items.summary: 时间码让多机位和录音机在后期的第一分钟就对上；没有它，合板要靠运气。

items.title: Timecode: Sync Without Guessing
items.summary: Timecode syncs cameras and recorders in the first minute of post; without it, sync is luck.

items.title: 三脚架：云台与承重
items.summary: 三脚架先看承重和云台，不看最大高度；相机加镜头加配件，往往比标称重。

items.title: Tripod: Load and Head
items.summary: Check payload and head before max height; camera, lens, and accessories weigh more than the spec.

items.title: 视频助理：现场回放
items.summary: 视频助理负责回放、标记和备份；导演能立刻看到刚才那条，拍摄速度会快很多.

items.title: Video Assist: Playback on Set
items.summary: Video assist handles playback, marks, and backup; instant review speeds the whole set.

items.title: 无线图传：延迟与干扰
items.summary: 无线图传先测延迟和干扰，再决定给导演还是给跟焦；信号断了，现场就会停。

items.title: Wireless Video: Latency and Interference
items.summary: Test latency and interference before sending to director or focus puller; a dropped signal stops the set.

items.title: 变焦镜头：方便与画质
items.summary: 变焦镜头省时间，但要在重量、光圈和画质之间付账；先问今天最缺哪一样。

items.title: Zoom Lens: Convenience Has a Cost
items.summary: A zoom saves time but charges you in weight, aperture, and image; ask which one you can afford today.

items.title: 画幅比计算器：裁切与安全区
items.summary: 画幅比计算器先算裁切后的有效像素，再定安全区；竖屏不是横屏两边裁掉。

items.title: Aspect Ratio Calculator: Crop and Safe Area
items.summary: Calculate effective pixels after crop, then safe area; vertical is not a horizontal crop.

items.title: 码率体积计算器：文件多大
items.summary: 码率计算器按分钟和 Mbps 算文件体积；交付前先知道硬盘够不够。

items.title: Bitrate Calculator: How Big Is the File?
items.summary: Calculate file size from minutes and Mbps; know if the drive fits before delivery.

items.title: 预算计算器：四块怎么分
items.summary: 预算计算器把制作费分成四块：人、设备、场地、后期；每块留 10% 缓冲。

items.title: Budget Calculator: Four Buckets
items.summary: Split the budget into people, gear, location, and post; keep ten percent buffer.

items.title: 景深计算器：距离与光圈
items.summary: 景深计算器先看主体距离，再看光圈和焦段；距离一变，景深全变。

items.title: Depth of Field Calculator: Distance and Aperture
items.summary: Depth of field starts with subject distance, then aperture and focal length; move and everything changes.

items.title: ND 计算器：换滤镜不靠猜
items.summary: ND 计算器把快门、光圈、ISO 和目标曝光放进同一个公式；换滤镜前先算。

items.title: ND Calculator: Change Filters Without Guessing
items.summary: The ND calculator puts shutter, aperture, ISO, and target exposure in one formula; calculate before swapping.

items.title: 存储时长计算器：卡能录多久
items.summary: 存储计算器按码率、时长和备份份数算空间；卡能录多久，不要靠相机剩余时间。

items.title: Storage Calculator: How Long Can You Roll?
items.summary: Calculate space from bitrate, duration, and copies; do not trust the camera's remaining-time guess.

items.title: 字幕 CPS 计算器：读得完吗
items.summary: 字幕 CPS 计算器看每秒字符数；超过阅读速度，观众会暂停，片子就断了。

items.title: Subtitle CPS: Can They Read It?
items.summary: Check characters per second; above reading speed, the viewer pauses and the film breaks.

items.title: 镜头视角计算器：焦距、画幅与水平视角
items.summary: 输入传感器宽度和焦距，算出水平视角；用来判断这支镜头在室内、户外和人物近景里够不够用。

items.title: Lens Field-of-View Calculator: Focal Length, Sensor, and Horizontal Angle
items.summary: Enter sensor width and focal length to estimate horizontal field of view, and decide whether a lens is wide enough for a room, a landscape, or a close-up.

items.title: 动画史：从赛璐珞到 3D
items.summary: 从纸、赛璐珞到多边形，工具换了几轮，动画师每天面对的仍是同一个问题：怎么让静止的东西看起来想动。

items.title: Animation History: From Cels to 3D
items.summary: Paper, cels, polygons: the tools changed. Animators still face the same daily problem: how to make a still thing look like it wants to move.

items.title: 1895：电影成为公共娱乐
items.summary: 卢米埃尔兄弟把放映变成买票、坐下、一起看。电影从技术演示变成了一种公共时间。

items.title: 1895: Cinema Becomes Public Entertainment
items.summary: The Lumières turned projection into a ticket, a seat, and a shared audience. Cinema moved from technical demo to public time.

items.title: 从银版到手机：摄影的五次转身
items.summary: 1839 年要坐着不动几十秒，1888 年柯达把相机交给普通人，1975 年传感器把光变成文件，2007 年手机让拍照变成默认动作。

items.title: From Daguerreotype to Phone: Five Turns in Photography
items.summary: In 1839 you sat still for dozens of seconds. In 1888 Kodak handed the camera to ordinary people. In 1975 a sensor turned light into a file. In 2007 the phone made photographing the default.

items.title: AI 内容标识：显式、隐式与平台责任
items.summary: AI 生成内容不是“标注一下”就合规。中国大陆的标识规则区分显式标识与隐式标识，平台、工具提供者、发布者各有义务；广告与新闻场景更严。

items.title: AI Content Labels: Explicit, Implicit, and Platform Duties
items.summary: AI content is not compliant with a single “AI” tag. China mainland rules distinguish explicit and implicit labels, with duties for platforms, tool providers, and publishers; ads and news are stricter.

items.title: 合同范围：把“再改一版”写进价格之前
items.summary: 影视合同最常见的争议不是付款，是范围。交付物、修改轮次、素材版权、验收标准、终止条件没写清，最后都会变成免费加班。

items.title: Contract Scope: Price the “One More Revision” Before It Happens
items.summary: The most common film contract dispute is not payment; it is scope. Unclear deliverables, revisions, rights, acceptance, and termination become unpaid overtime.

items.title: 器材与制作保险：保什么、不保什么
items.summary: 设备险不是“坏了就赔”。要区分财产一切险、机器损坏险、公众责任险、货运险；免赔额、折旧、除外责任和理赔材料决定你能不能拿到钱。

items.title: Equipment and Production Insurance: What Is Covered, What Is Not
items.summary: Equipment insurance is not “broken, paid.” Separate property all-risks, machinery breakdown, public liability, and transit; deductibles, depreciation, exclusions, and claim documents decide payout.

items.title: 跨境制作发票与税务：合同、发票、代扣代缴
items.summary: 跨境项目最容易在“发票”上卡住：客户要的形式发票不是税务发票；服务发生地、收款主体、常设机构、代扣代缴决定税负。先让财税确认路径，再报价。

items.title: Cross-border Production Invoices and Tax: Contract, Invoice, Withholding
items.summary: Cross-border projects stall on “invoices”: a proforma invoice is not a tax invoice. Place of service, receiving entity, permanent establishment, and withholding decide the tax. Confirm the path before quoting.

items.title: 音乐授权：同步权、表演权与平台曲库
items.summary: “买了这首歌”不等于“能商用”。影视项目至少要区分同步权（把歌录进片子）、表演权（公开播放）、机械复制权（复制音频）和录音制作者权。

items.title: Music Licensing: Sync, Performance, and Platform Libraries
items.summary: “I bought the song” does not mean “I can use it commercially.” Film projects must separate sync (recording into the film), performance (public playback), mechanical (copying audio), and master rights.

items.title: 肖像、场地与未成年人授权：一张 Release 要写什么
items.summary: 拍摄同意不等于商用同意。肖像权、场地物权、未成年人监护人同意、AI 换脸/合成，是四份不同的授权；一张“同意拍摄”纸条救不了广告投放。

items.title: Likeness, Location, and Minors: What a Release Must Say
items.summary: Consent to be filmed is not consent to be used commercially. Likeness, property, guardian consent for minors, and AI face/voice synthesis are four different clearances; a “consent to shoot” note will not save a paid ad.

items.title: 媒介素养：一条视频的五个问题
items.summary: 不要先问“真的假的”，先问：谁做的、剪掉了什么、放在什么语境、为什么现在推给我。

items.title: Media Literacy: Five Questions for Any Video
items.summary: Do not start with “is it real.” Start with: who made it, what was cut, what context, and why it reached me now.

items.title: 版权：先查五件事，再发布
items.summary: 画面、音乐、字体、肖像、场地，五项分别授权。CC 与商用授权不是一回事。

items.title: Rights: Check Five Things Before Publishing
items.summary: Footage, music, fonts, likeness, and location are five separate permissions. CC is not a commercial license.

items.title: 脸为什么越来越近：从影院到手机
items.summary: 景别不是导演突然爱拍特写，是屏幕变了。影院银幕能装下一张脸，电视只给你一个客厅，手机只给你拇指宽。观众离画面越近，脸就得越大。

items.title: Why Faces Got Closer: Cinema to Phone
items.summary: Faces did not get closer because directors fell in love with close-ups. The screen changed. Cinema could hold a face; TV gave it a living room; the phone gives it a thumb.

items.title: 16mm：电影从影院走到教室
items.summary: 16mm 让摄影机变轻、变便宜，电影从影院走进教室、工厂和田野。

items.title: 16mm: Cinema Left the Theater
items.summary: 16mm made cameras light and cheap, taking cinema into classrooms, factories, and fields.

items.title: AI 影像前史：从滤镜到生成
items.summary: AI 影像不是从生成视频开始；滤镜、修复、抠像、换脸，每一步都在训练“自动修改画面”。

items.title: AI Video Prehistory: From Filters to Generation
items.summary: AI video did not start with generation; filters, restoration, matting, and face swap each trained automatic image changes.

items.title: 暗箱：图像先学会倒过来
items.summary: 暗箱早就知道光会成像，真正的新东西是它把“看见”变成可以复制的证据。

items.title: Camera Obscura: The Image Learned to Stand Upside Down
items.summary: The camera obscura already knew light could form an image; what changed was turning sight into reproducible evidence.

items.title: 数字影院：胶片退场
items.summary: 数字影院把胶片从放映环节拿掉，影院开始用硬盘和服务器放映。

items.title: Digital Cinema: Film Left the Projector
items.summary: Digital cinema removed film from projection; theaters began running from drives and servers.

items.title: 单反拍视频：电影感下沉
items.summary: 单反拍视频把大传感器和可换镜头交给普通人，电影感开始下沉。

items.title: DSLR Video: The Cinematic Look Went Downmarket
items.summary: DSLR video put big sensors and interchangeable lenses in ordinary hands; the cinematic look went downmarket.

items.title: 爱迪生 Kinetoscope：一个人看的电影
items.summary: 活动电影放映机把影像装进盒子，一次只给一个人看；电影还没成为公共空间。

items.title: Edison's Kinetoscope: Cinema for One
items.summary: The Kinetoscope put moving images in a box for one viewer; cinema had not become a public space yet.

items.title: 卢米埃尔：火车进站吓到观众
items.summary: 卢米埃尔把火车进站投在墙上，观众第一次被“假的东西”吓到。

items.title: Lumière: The Train That Made People Flinch
items.summary: The Lumière brothers projected a train arriving, and the audience flinched at something not there.

items.title: 蒙太奇：镜头开始有因果
items.summary: 蒙太奇把两个不相干的镜头剪在一起，观众开始自己造因果。

items.title: Montage: Shots Learned to Mean
items.summary: Montage cut unrelated shots together and let the audience build the cause.

items.title: 迈布里奇：马跑起来的那一秒
items.summary: 迈布里奇用一排相机拆开马的运动，第一次让人看见肉眼来不及看的瞬间。

items.title: Muybridge: The Second a Horse Ran
items.summary: Muybridge lined up cameras to split a horse's gait and showed a moment the eye could not catch.

items.title: 1839：摄影第一次变成可复制的图像
items.summary: 达盖尔法公布后，图像第一次能稳定地留在金属板上，也被复制、传播和收藏。它改变了“看见”的权力。

items.title: 1839: Photography Becomes a Reproducible Image
items.summary: After the Daguerreotype was made public, images could be fixed on metal, copied, circulated, and collected. It changed who could claim to show the world.

items.title: 手机影像：人人都有摄影机
items.summary: 手机影像把摄影机变成随身物，拍摄从事件变成日常。

items.title: Smartphone Video: Everyone Has a Camera
items.summary: Smartphone video made the camera wearable; shooting moved from event to everyday.

items.title: 有声片：观众第一次听见对白
items.summary: 有声片让电影从“看动作”变成“听人说话”，也逼着摄影棚改变拍法。

items.title: Sound Era: The Voice Arrived
items.summary: Sound turned cinema from watching action to hearing people, and forced studios to change how they shot.

items.title: 流媒体：观看从频道变成列表
items.summary: 流媒体把观看从频道时间表变成一张列表，片长和开头都被重新设计。

items.title: Streaming: Watching Became a List
items.summary: Streaming turned viewing from a schedule into a list, and redesigned length and openings.

items.title: 特艺彩色：颜色变成卖点
items.summary: 特艺彩色不是自然色，它把颜色变成奇观，让观众愿意为“更红”买票。

items.title: Technicolor: Color Became a Selling Point
items.summary: Technicolor was not natural color; it made color a spectacle worth buying a ticket for.

items.title: 特效史：从玻璃绘景到 CG
items.summary: 特效史从玻璃绘景、微缩模型走到 CG，工具变了，问题还是“怎么让假的东西可信”。

items.title: VFX History: From Glass Paintings to CG
items.summary: VFX moved from glass paintings and miniatures to CG; tools changed, the problem stayed: make the fake believable.

items.title: 录像带：电视可以重播
items.summary: 录像带让电视不再只能直播，节目可以录、可以剪、可以重播。

items.title: Video Tape: Television Could Replay
items.summary: Video tape freed television from live-only and made recording, editing, and replay possible.

items.title: 无障碍字幕：让听不见的人也跟上
items.summary: 无障碍字幕要让听不见的人知道谁在说、发生了什么、语气是什么，不只写台词。

items.title: Accessible Captions: Let People Who Cannot Hear Follow
items.summary: Accessible captions tell Deaf viewers who speaks, what happens, and how it sounds, not just the words.

items.title: 素材安全：客户隐私与泄露
items.summary: 素材安全包括硬盘、云盘、聊天记录和转发权限；客户隐私不是只有正片。

items.title: Data Security: Client Privacy and Leaks
items.summary: Data security covers drives, cloud, chat, and forwarding; client privacy is not only the final cut.

items.title: 纪录片伦理：拍脆弱的人
items.summary: 拍脆弱的人先问三件事：他知不知道后果、能不能退出、片子会不会伤害他。

items.title: Documentary Ethics: Filming Vulnerable People
items.summary: Ask three things: does he know the consequence, can he withdraw, and can the film hurt him.

items.title: 场地许可：纸要写什么
items.summary: 场地许可写清拍摄时间、区域、干扰、损坏责任和成片使用权。

items.title: Location Release: What the Paper Says
items.summary: A location release states hours, areas, disruption, damage, and footage rights.

items.title: 隐私与打码：什么时候必须处理
items.summary: 打码不是礼貌，是义务：住址、车牌、病历、未成年人，能识别就要处理。

items.title: Privacy and Blurring: When It Is Required
items.summary: Blurring is not politeness; addresses, plates, medical records, and minors need protection when identifiable.

items.title: 算法推荐：为什么你总看到同一种
items.summary: 算法推荐按停留和互动放大相似内容；你越停，它越认定你喜欢。

items.title: Algorithm Feed: Why the Same Thing Again?
items.summary: Feeds amplify what holds attention; the longer you stay, the more it assumes you like it.

items.title: 标题党：标题承诺了什么，正文给了什么
items.summary: 标题党先承诺一个强结果，正文只给一个弱例子；判断方法是把标题和正文各写一句。

items.title: Clickbait: What the Title Promises, What the Body Gives
items.summary: Clickbait promises a strong result and delivers a weak example; summarize title and body separately.

items.title: 深伪识别：看脸之外看什么
items.summary: 深伪识别别只看脸；看牙齿、耳朵、眨眼、背景文字和光影方向。

items.title: Deepfake Detection: Look Beyond the Face
items.summary: Look beyond the face: teeth, ears, blinks, background text, and light direction.

items.title: 剪辑操控：删掉哪一句改变了意思
items.summary: 剪辑操控常常只删一句话：删掉前提，结论就变了。

items.title: Edit Manipulation: Which Sentence Was Cut?
items.summary: Editing manipulation often removes one sentence; cut the premise and the conclusion changes.

items.title: 新闻视频：现场、二手信源与核实
items.summary: 新闻视频先分现场、二手信源和核实；没有核实的“现场”只是素材。

items.title: News Video: Scene, Secondhand Source, Verification
items.summary: Separate scene, secondhand source, and verification; an unverified scene is just footage.

items.title: 平台规则：什么会被限流
items.summary: 平台规则不是玄学；重复搬运、夸大承诺、诱导互动和敏感画面，是最常见的限流点。

items.title: Platform Rules: What Gets Throttled
items.summary: Platform limits are not magic: reposts, exaggerated promises, engagement bait, and sensitive images get throttled.

items.title: 来源核查：这条视频最初是谁发的
items.summary: 来源核查先找最初发布者，再找原始文件；转发十万次，也不等于真实。

items.title: Source Check: Who Posted It First?
items.summary: Find the first poster and the original file; a hundred thousand reposts prove nothing.

items.title: 赞助披露：广告要让人看见
items.summary: 赞助披露要在观众看到推荐之前出现，不要藏在简介最后一行。

items.title: Sponsorship Disclosure: Make the Ad Visible
items.summary: Disclose sponsorship before the recommendation, not in the last line of the description.

items.title: 数据视频：图表有没有骗人
items.summary: 数据视频先看坐标轴从哪开始、总数是多少、比较的是不是同一群人。

items.title: Statistics Video: Did the Chart Lie?
items.summary: Check where the axis starts, what the total is, and whether the same group is compared.
